items.title: 傳統豪華品牌也撐不住了 從BBA到二線豪華都在降
items.title_en: Even Traditional Luxury Brands Can’t Hold On Anymore, From BBA to Second‑Tier Luxury All Cutting Prices
paras: 有車型售價接近腰斬，傳統豪華品牌售價集體「失守」，「沃爾沃S90從（人民幣，下同）40萬降到22萬」的詞條20日（周日）在中國社交媒體平台衝上了熱搜。
沃爾沃S90是沃爾沃旗下一款中大型轎車，官方指導價格為40.69萬元起，但從第三方平台上的經銷商報價來看，入門版目前價格為22.99萬元，較官方指導價下降17.7萬元，降價幅度約43.50%，接近腰斬。
沃爾沃S90並不是孤例，多款車型的經銷商報價降價幅度都在30%以上，尤其是與沃爾沃S90同級的傳統豪華品牌中大型轎車。
從與沃爾沃S90的BBA同級車型來看，奧迪A6L部分款型在北京經銷商報價為28.16萬元，較官方指導價下降17.33萬元，降價幅度約38.10%。
近年來傳統豪車降價的新聞一波接一波，從BBA到二線豪華品牌，從轎車到SUV，幾乎無一倖免，整個傳統豪華車陣營的價格體系正在經歷一場鬆動。
《車東西》指出，傳統豪華車型價格體系崩塌，是多重原因同時擠壓的結果。
最直接的寒意來自車市大盤整體收縮。根據乘聯分會發布的數據，今年8月全中國乘用車零售為154.1萬輛，較一年前驟降23.6%。
新能源車滲透率達到65.2%歷史新高，也讓以燃油車為主的傳統豪華品牌雪上加霜。
乘聯分會的數據顯示，8月燃油車零售較去年同期銳減40%，其中純燃油車狂降45%，燃油車中主流合資下降40%，豪華品牌下滑33%。
paras_en: Some models are seeing prices cut almost in half, with traditional luxury brands collectively “losing ground”. The headline “Volvo S90 drops from 400,000 yuan to 220,000 yuan” trended on Chinese social media on the 20th (Sunday).

The Volvo S90 is a mid‑size sedan under the Volvo brand, officially priced from 406,900 yuan. However, dealer quotes on third‑party platforms show the entry‑level version now costs 229,900 yuan, a drop of 177,000 yuan from the official guide price, roughly a 43.5% reduction, close to a halving of the price.
The Volvo S90 is not an isolated case; many models are seeing dealer‑quoted price cuts of over 30%, especially mid‑size sedans from traditional luxury brands that compete with the S90.
Looking at BBA models comparable to the Volvo S90, some Audi A6L trims in Beijing are quoted at 281,600 yuan, down 173,300 yuan from the official guide price, a reduction of about 38.1%.

In recent years, news of price cuts for traditional luxury cars has been coming in waves—from BBA to second‑tier luxury brands, from sedans to SUVs, almost none are spared. The entire pricing structure of the traditional luxury car camp is undergoing a loosening.
According to “Car Things”, the collapse of the traditional luxury car pricing system is the result of multiple pressures converging at once.

The most immediate chill comes from a overall contraction in the auto market. Data released by the China Passenger Car Association shows that retail sales of passenger cars in China in August this year were 1.541 million units, a sharp 23.6% drop from a year earlier.
The penetration rate of new‑energy vehicles hit a historic high of 65.2%, further squeezing traditional luxury brands that rely mainly on gasoline cars.

Data from the China Passenger Car Association indicates that August retail sales of gasoline cars fell sharply by 40% year‑on‑year, with pure gasoline models plunging 45%, mainstream joint‑venture gasoline models down 40%, and luxury brands slipping 33%.

items.title: 〈國泰金經濟調查〉9月景氣樂觀情緒、股市風險偏好回升 仍憂民生物價影響通膨
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Economic Survey: September Optimism and Stock Market Risk Appetite Rebound, Yet Concerns Over Consumer Prices and Inflation
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(21)日發布2026年9月國民經濟信心調查結果，民眾景氣現況與展望樂觀指數雙雙反彈，大額消費意願同步走揚；受惠於AI基本面強勁支撐，台股樂觀情緒與風險偏好大幅回升。經濟成長方面，逾五成民眾預估全年經濟成長率將突破11%，展現對景氣的強勁信心；惟物價看法依然偏向嚴峻，過半民眾預期全年通膨高於2.5%，且近八成民眾認為一年後通膨率將持續超過2%。
國發會最新公布的7月景氣對策信號續呈紅燈，領先指標及同時指標續呈上升，景氣仍呈穩健成長。國泰金本月調查顯示，民眾的景氣樂觀指數反彈，其中景氣現況樂觀指數上升至14.8，展望樂觀指數上升至16.5。消費意願也同步改善，其中大額消費意願指數升至18.3，耐久財消費意願指數升至-3.9。

主計總處於2026年8月14日預估台灣2026年經濟成長率11.05%，通貨膨脹率2.07%。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於2026年經濟成長率的平均預期值為10.89%，有52%的民眾認為2026年經濟成長率會高於11%；而民眾對於2026年平均通膨預期值為2.51%，且有高達51%的民眾認為2026年通貨膨脹率會高於2.5%。相較於主計總處，民眾對於2026年的經濟成長預估與主計總處接近，但通膨預期依舊較高。
雖美伊談判持續，然美國通膨數據未大幅上升，且四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)續上修資本支出，財報優於預期支撐AI基本面，帶動台股走升。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於台股的樂觀指數回升至49.1，風險偏好指數上升至32.9。
關於民眾對一年後通貨膨脹率看法的調查，本月的調查結果顯示，79%的民眾預期一年以後通貨膨脹率大於2%，其中35%民眾預期將大於3%。另外，15%民眾覺得一年以後通貨膨脹率介於1%至2%。
針對民眾對未來一年物價漲跌判斷的主要因素，本月的調查結果顯示，有35%民眾認為未來一年物價漲跌主要受到日常消費價格影響(例如：外食、蔬菜水果、民生日用品等)，另有29%民眾認為進口原物料價格(例如：原油、鋼鐵等)，是未來一年物價漲跌判斷的主要因素。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) released the results of its September 2026 National Economic Confidence Survey today (21st). Both the public’s current‑economy optimism index and outlook optimism index rebounded, and willingness for large‑ticket purchases rose in tandem; buoyed by strong AI fundamentals, Taiwanese stock‑market optimism and risk appetite surged. Over half of respondents expect the annual economic growth rate to exceed 11%, showing strong confidence in the economy, but price expectations remain severe, with more than half anticipating inflation above 2.5% for the year and nearly 80% believing inflation will stay above 2% a year from now.

The National Development Council’s latest July economic‑policy signal remains red, with leading and coincident indicators continuing to rise, indicating steady growth. Cathay’s survey this month shows a rebound in the public’s economy‑optimism index, with the current‑economy optimism index climbing to 14.8 and the outlook optimism index to 16.5. Consumption willingness also improved, with the large‑ticket consumption index rising to 18.3 and the durable‑goods consumption index to –3.9.

The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics estimated on August 14, 2026 that Taiwan’s 2026 economic growth rate would be 11.05% and inflation 2.07%. This month’s survey shows the public’s average expected growth rate for 2026 at 10.89%, with 52% believing growth will exceed 11%; the average inflation expectation is 2.51%, and a record 51% think inflation will be above 2.5%. Compared with the official forecast, public growth expectations are close, but inflation expectations remain higher.

Despite ongoing US‑Iran talks, US inflation data has not risen sharply, and the four major cloud service providers (CSPs) have continued to raise capital‑expenditure plans, with earnings beating expectations and supporting AI fundamentals, driving the Taiwanese market higher. This month’s survey shows the public’s optimism index for the Taiwan stock market rebounded to 49.1, and the risk‑appetite index rose to 32.9.

Regarding expectations for inflation a year from now, this month’s survey shows 79% of respondents expect inflation to be above 2% in a year, with 35% expecting it to exceed 3%. Additionally, 15% think inflation a year ahead will be between 1% and 2%.

When asked what they consider the main driver of price changes over the next year, 35% of respondents said everyday consumer prices (e.g., dining out, fruits and vegetables, daily necessities) and 29% pointed to import raw‑material prices (e.g., crude oil, steel) as the primary factors.

items.title: 【中秋變盤倒數】別急著逃！台股真正的「未爆彈」竟是這3個字？
items.title_en: Mid-Autumn Countdown: Don’t Rush to Flee! The Real “Unexploded Bomb” in Taiwan Stocks Is Just Three Words
paras: 最近很多人，一下擔心美國利率，一下怕油價上漲，現在又看到記憶體價格有雜音，又開始懷疑AI是不是要退燒。一看到手中股票下跌，就忍不住想：「是不是中秋要變盤了！該先跑了？」。若是如此，你恐怕將錯失第四季的台股大行情！
我們從技術面來看，台股只要守住 45,900 至 45,973 點的跳空缺口，隨著季線連續扣低，多頭均線即將呈現「萬佛朝宗」的大多頭排列。歷史數據更告訴我們，中秋過後的第四季上漲機率高達九成，在 AI 時代近三年節後平均漲幅更有 8%。所以，本周若因中秋連假出現賣壓，股價出現拉回不是讓你害怕，而是主力用心提供給你的黃金買點。
重點來了！該買什麼？江江的忠實鐵粉都知道，答案只有三個字「電、光、熱」！因為現在真正的問題，已經不是「AI有沒有需求」，而是：AI晶片愈來愈強，電夠不夠？資料跑得動嗎？熱散得掉嗎？這才是第四季台股值得注意的地方。
第一個「電」：AI愈強，吃電也愈兇
你家裡如果同時開冷氣、電鍋、烤箱、吹風機，偶爾是不是會跳電？AI資料中心其實也一樣。只是人家不是開幾台家電，而是一次塞進大量高功率AI伺服器。所以未來資料中心最大的問題之一就是：電從哪裡來？怎麼穩定供電？這也是為什麼800V電力架構開始受到市場注意。
核心指標廠：台達電(2308-TW) 作為電力升級的核心主導者，釋出了大量電力架構與備援訂單。
受惠潛力股：承接台達電大訂單的新盛力(4931-TW)；電力備援概念股-高力(8996-TW) 以及相關被動元件、二極體與功率元件廠 強茂(2481-TW)，都是電力升級潮下的真贏家。
第二個：光（CPO 矽光子與高速光傳輸）：未來三年的爆發主力
當晶片運算速度達到極限，傳統銅線傳輸就會變成嚴重的塞車瓶頸。台積電(2330-TW) 已經明確定義矽光子（CPO）為核心升級路徑，高層更公開預估 CPO 將在今年下半年啟動量產，2027 年矽光子在光收發模組的滲透率將突破 50%。
核心指標廠：包含 聯亞(3081-TW)、華星光(4979-TW)、上詮(3363-TW) 等光通訊關鍵廠商，已被台積電(2330-TW)認證為光連結驅動未來的核心要角。
第三個「熱」：AI晶片太熱，反而變成商機
最後一個「熱」，可能是一般投資人最容易理解的。手機用久了會發燙。電腦跑大型遊戲，也會發燙。那麼問題來了：如果一顆AI晶片比以前的晶片強很多，它會不會也更熱？答案當然是會。而且AI伺服器不是一台電腦而已，是大量高功耗晶片塞在一起。
所以以前吹風扇、散熱片就能解決的問題，現在開始需要更進階的水冷、液冷，甚至微流道散熱。這也是為什麼奇鋐(3017)、健策(3653)、雙鴻(3324)等散熱廠商受到市場關注。
最後，還有底層支撐：廠務、測試與指標記憶體
除了電光熱之外，廠務與測試更是真金白銀的明證。台積電(2330-TW)與 美光(MU-US) 擴產踩油門，讓廠務工程龍頭 漢唐(2404-TW)、亞翔(6139-TW) 訂單能見度排到 2028 年；晶圓測試大廠 京元電子(2449-TW) 也砸下重金大舉擴充 AI ASIC 與 GPU 測試設備，需求極度強勁。
至於記憶體，雖然本周有零星報價下修的雜音，但合約價與基本面並未惡化，聰明的資金應集中在華邦電(2344-TW) 與 南亞科(2408-TW) 等具備技術優勢的指標股上。

paras_en: Recently many people have been worrying about U.S. interest rates, fearing rising oil prices, and now hearing noise about memory prices, leading them to doubt whether AI is cooling off. When they see their stocks falling, they can’t help but think, “Is the market about to turn this Mid‑Autumn? Should I run now?” If so, you may miss the big Taiwan market rally in Q4!

From a technical perspective, as long as Taiwan’s market holds the gap between 45,900 and 45,973 points, the seasonal line will keep being pressed lower, and the bullish moving averages are about to form a massive “ten‑thousand‑Buddha” alignment. Historical data also shows that the probability of a rise in Q4 after Mid‑Autumn is as high as 90%, with an average post‑holiday gain of 8% in the AI era over the past three years. So if selling pressure appears during the Mid‑Autumn holiday this week and prices pull back, it’s not something to fear—it’s a golden buying opportunity deliberately offered by the main players.

Here’s the key! What should you buy? Jiang‑Jiang’s loyal fans know the answer is just three characters: “Electricity, Light, Heat.” The real issue now isn’t whether AI has demand, but whether the AI chips are getting stronger, is there enough power? Can the data run? Can the heat be dissipated? Those are the points to watch in Taiwan’s market for Q4.
First “Electricity”: The stronger the AI, the more power it devours.

If you run the air‑conditioner, rice cooker, oven and hair dryer all at once at home, you sometimes get a power outage, right? AI data centers face the same problem—but instead of a few home appliances, they pack a massive amount of high‑power AI servers. Thus, one of the biggest challenges for future data centers is: where does the electricity come from, and how to keep the supply stable? This is why the 800 V power‑grid architecture is drawing market attention.
Core indicator company: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) is the leading player in power‑upgrade solutions and has released a large volume of power‑architecture and backup orders.

Beneficiary stocks: New Sheng Li (4931‑TW), which takes on Delta’s big orders; backup‑power concept stock G‑Power (8996‑TW); and related passive component, diode and power‑device maker Strong‑Mao (2481‑TW) – all true winners in the power‑upgrade wave.
Second: Light (CPO silicon photonics and high‑speed optical transmission) – the main driver for the next three years.

When chip compute speeds hit their limits, traditional copper wiring becomes a severe bottleneck. TSMC (2330‑TW) has clearly defined silicon photonics (CPO) as a core upgrade path, and senior management publicly estimates CPO will start mass production in the second half of this year, with silicon‑photonic penetration in optical transceiver modules exceeding 50% by 2027.

Core indicator companies: Lian‑Ya (3081‑TW), Huaxing Light (4979‑TW), Shang‑Chuan (3363‑TW) and other key optical‑communication firms have been certified by TSMC (2330‑TW) as the core drivers of future optical links.
Third “Heat”: Over‑hot AI chips become a business opportunity.

The final “Heat” is probably the easiest for ordinary investors to grasp. Phones get hot after prolonged use. PCs heating up while running heavy games is familiar. The question is: if an AI chip is much more powerful than previous chips, will it also run hotter? The answer is yes. Moreover, an AI server isn’t just one computer; it’s a massive array of high‑power chips packed together.

Therefore, problems that used to be solved with fans or heat‑sinks now require advanced water‑cooling, liquid‑cooling, or even micro‑channel cooling. That’s why thermal‑solution companies such as Qihong (3017), Jiance (3653) and Shuang‑Hong (3324) are gaining market focus.
Finally, there’s the underlying support: fab operations, testing and benchmark memory.

Beyond electricity, light and heat, fab operations and testing are the real cash generators. TSMC (2330‑TW) and Micron (MU‑US) are accelerating capacity expansions, giving order visibility for fab‑engineering leaders Han‑Tang (2404‑TW) and Yaxiang (6139‑TW) out to 2028; wafer‑testing giant Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) is also pouring heavy investment into expanding AI ASIC and GPU testing equipment, reflecting extremely strong demand.

As for memory, although there were some scattered price‑cut rumors this week, contract prices and fundamentals have not deteriorated. Smart capital should focus on benchmark stocks with technical advantages such as Winbond (2344‑TW) and Nanya Technology (2408‑TW).

items.title: 貝森特盛讚美中磋商「非常成功」 雙方將建立AI通報機制
items.title_en: Biden Praises US-China Talks as "Extremely Successful," Both Sides to Set Up AI Notification Mechanism
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特表示，在美中兩國元首本週舉行峰會前夕，他與中國中方官員就人工智慧、貿易與投資等議題展開的談話「非常成功」。
貝森特在紐約與中國國務院副總理何立峰等官員進行數小時會談後向記者表示，雙方同意建立AI對話機制，並就共同目標與威脅交換意見。雙方計畫再次會晤，中國國際貿易談判代表李成鋼表示，工作小組周一將繼續磋商。
貝森特說：「美方提議在兩國之間建立通報機制，我們希望對共同目標與共同威脅形成一致看法。」他並指出，這項機制將命名為「美中AI對話」。
美國貿易代表葛里爾（Jamieson Greer）表示，雙方正在為川普總統與習近平主席週四的成功會晤「奠定基礎」。李成鋼先前則表示，此次磋商氣氛良好。
貝森特與何立峰上一次面對面會談，是約4個月前在首爾附近舉行，當時距離川普5月訪問北京僅數日。川普本周四，將在白宮接待習近平，這也是這位中國領導人十多年來首度對華府進行國是訪問。
此次會談的首要議題之一，是延長美中貿易休戰協議。雙方先前均調降關稅並放寬出口限制，但相關協議將於11月到期。
消息人士透露，針對貿易夥伴產能過剩指控而研擬的新一輪美國關稅公告，已決定延至此次會後再行公布。
《彭博》先前報導，美中雙方正積極尋求降低美國能源與農產品的關稅；這是今年稍早啟動的「貿易委員會」機制之一環，旨在藉由更廣泛的倡議，消弭雙方各值300億美元商品的貿易壁壘。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said that the discussions she held with Chinese officials on artificial intelligence, trade and investment were "extremely successful" on the eve of the summit between the two heads of state this week.

After several hours of talks in New York with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and other officials, Yellen told reporters that the parties agreed to establish an AI dialogue mechanism and to exchange views on shared goals and threats. The two sides plan to meet again, and China’s international trade negotiation representative Li Chenggang said the working group will continue its talks on Monday.

Yellen said: "The U.S. proposes to set up a notification mechanism between the two countries, and we hope to reach a common view on shared objectives and threats." She added that the mechanism will be called the "U.S.-China AI Dialogue."

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the two sides are laying the groundwork for a successful meeting on Thursday between President Trump and President Xi Jinping. Li Chenggang previously noted that the atmosphere of the talks was positive.

The last face‑to‑face meeting between Yellen and He Lifeng was about four months ago near Seoul, just days before Trump’s May visit to Beijing. This Thursday, Trump will host Xi at the White House, marking the Chinese leader’s first state visit to Washington in more than a decade.

One of the primary topics of the meeting was extending the U.S.-China trade cease‑fire agreement. Both sides have previously lowered tariffs and eased export restrictions, but the agreement is set to expire in November.
Sources said that a new round of U.S. tariff announcements being drafted in response to accusations of overcapacity by trade partners has been postponed until after this meeting.

Bloomberg previously reported that the U.S. and China are actively seeking to reduce tariffs on U.S. energy and agricultural products; this is part of the "Trade Committee" mechanism launched earlier this year, aimed at removing trade barriers on roughly $30 billion worth of goods on each side.

items.title_en: Retail Investors Fear Getting Stuck at Peak Prices—Smart Stock Selection App Deploys Three Strategies to Boost Picking Efficiency

paras_en: Taiwan stock trading is lively, with a massive amount of market information and rapid sector rotation. Investors who blindly chase hot themes often face the risk of getting stuck at high points and price corrections. Accurately filtering stocks that have fundamental, capital, or momentum support amid the complex data becomes key to investment decisions.

According to a street survey by Juheng.com on users’ habits of viewing markets and placing orders, most respondents frequently watch the market, but in practice they commonly face pain points such as "not enough time to research individual stocks," "high threshold for understanding financial data," and "easily influenced by community sentiment and market mood."

The same survey found that many respondents also said they had previously suffered losses by chasing hot themes, entering at peak prices or misjudging trends, and even facing long-term lock‑ups. Therefore, in addition to order speed and interface smoothness, investors also value stock‑selection strategies and capital analysis. Most respondents expect the app to provide smart stock selection and daily key information organization, and are willing to pay between NT$100 and NT$500 per month for a fully functional decision‑support tool to lower the barrier to stock picking and strengthen investment judgment.

To help investors solve stock‑selection pain points, Yung‑Feng Securities’ "Big Investor" app offers a variety of smart stock‑selection strategies covering "short‑term focus," "capital report," and "wave‑selection"—three aspects that help investors quickly narrow down targets based on their trading habits and preferences, reduce time spent on individual research, and improve stock‑selection and decision efficiency.

Investors who like strong or popular stocks can use the "Short‑Term Focus" to grasp market mainstream. For example, the "Momentum Ranking" feature can instantly filter the top five percent of stocks with the highest weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly gains, allowing investors to monitor short‑term momentum changes. They can also observe whether a clear group sentiment appears in the strong‑stock ranking as a reference for subsequent market trend observation. Day‑traders can use the "Same‑Day Day‑Trade Ranking" to quickly pick the top 15 stocks with the highest same‑day day‑trade volumes, avoiding low‑liquidity obscure stocks and directly targeting market hot mainstream stocks.

If investors care about institutional and corporate trends, they can use the "Capital Report" to track capital flow. The system updates the "Active ETF Accumulation Stocks" for funds over NT$10 billion every morning at 8 am, summarizing the top 20 stocks bought by professional managers. It also provides strategies such as "Investment Trust Holdings Reach Three‑Year High" and "Foreign Investor Holdings Reach Three‑Year High," allowing investors to instantly track recent changes and layout trends of foreign and domestic investment trusts, facilitating a combined fundamental and technical assessment of entry timing.

Wave‑trading investors can use the "Wave‑Selection" strategy "Revenue‑High Model Student" to pick 10 high‑performing stocks whose monthly revenue and profits both hit new highs, helping investors avoid revenue inflation or core business losses.

On the execution side, the "Big Investor" app builds seven smart order types: quick order, stop‑loss/stop‑profit order, long‑term order, parent‑child order, moving exit order, multi‑condition order, and timed‑quantity order. The system automatically monitors market conditions based on the investor’s settings and sends orders, helping investors maintain trading discipline without constantly watching the market.

items.title: 卡達：美國希望與伊朗達成協議
items.title_en: Qatar: United States Hopes to Reach an Agreement with Iran
paras: 卡達外交部發言人馬吉德·安薩里20日（周日）表示，卡達正與美國和伊朗保持溝通，推動美伊恢復談判。他說，多名美國政府官員表示，美方希望達成協議，結束衝突。
安薩里在美國紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇期間表示，過去幾周卡達一直與美國和伊朗交換意見，努力彌合分歧，但他沒有給出談判恢復的時間表。
他說：「我們聽到多名美國政府官員表態，確認美國希望達成協議，希望找到結束這場戰爭的解決方案。」
安薩里表示，任何解決方案都應確保中東穩定，同時推動國際社會就保護包括荷姆茲海峽在內的戰略水道達成共識。他指出，曼德海峽目前也受到中東衝突影響。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部稱，情報顯示，美國為了掩蓋失敗，並試圖從這場戰爭中攫取利益，其在某歐洲國家舉行聯合會議後，已在某些中東地區國家默許下，決定再次對伊朗採取敵對行動。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部警告，一旦美國針對伊朗犯下任何錯誤，其在中東的所有基地及利益目標，都將毫無保留遭受持續、有效且慘痛的打擊。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部告誡各地區國家，若繼續對伊朗奉行「兩面派政策」，並與敵人合作，將被視為共犯，屆時將無法再指望伊朗武裝力量保持克制或容忍。
paras_en: Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesperson Majid Al-Ansari said on Sunday the 20th that Qatar is maintaining communications with the United States and Iran to push for a resumption of US‑Iran talks. He noted that several U.S. government officials have indicated that Washington wants to strike a deal and end the conflict.

During the Qatar Economic Forum in New York, Al‑Ansari said that over the past few weeks Qatar has been exchanging views with the United States and Iran, working to bridge differences, but he did not provide a timetable for the renewal of negotiations.
He said, “We have heard multiple U.S. officials state that the United States wants to reach an agreement and find a solution to end this war.”

Al‑Ansari added that any solution must ensure stability in the Middle East while also pushing the international community toward consensus on protecting strategic waterways, including the Hormuz Strait. He noted that the Strait of Mand also currently feels the impact of the Middle‑East conflict.

Iran’s Hatam Amria Central Command claimed that intelligence shows the United States, in order to cover up failures and try to profit from the war, after holding a joint meeting in a certain European country, has decided— with tacit approval from some Middle‑East states— to take hostile action against Iran again.

The Hatam Amria Central Command warned that if the United States makes any mistake against Iran, all of its bases and interest targets in the Middle East will face relentless, effective and painful strikes without restraint.

The Hatam Amria Central Command cautioned regional countries that if they continue to pursue a “double‑deal” policy toward Iran and cooperate with its enemies, they will be treated as accomplices and can no longer expect Iranian armed forces to exercise restraint or tolerance.

items.title: IBS最新預測：Token日耗數千兆、DRAM衝破上兆美元 半導體陷製程「先進缺、成熟剩」的超級短缺
items.title_en: IBS Latest Forecast: AI Tokens Consuming Trillions Daily, DRAM Surpassing a Trillion Dollars, Semiconductor Industry Faces a Super Shortage of ‘Advanced Process Deficit, Mature Process Surplus’
paras: 國際商業戰略公司(IBS)最新預測，全球半導體市場規模將由2020年4467億美元，升至2026年約1.586兆美元、2030年2.585兆美元、2035年4.678兆美元。IBS指出，原估2030年才達1兆美元的目標被AI提前約四年實現。
研調機構顧能(Gartner)亦給出相近總量，預估今年全球半導體收入1.6兆美元，較去年8090億美元增92%，其中記憶體收入約8370億美元、佔比升至54%，2027年記憶體有望破1兆美元。
需求端核心變量是推理token。根據IBS估算，中美每日AI token消耗將由去年Q1中國34兆、美國3兆，升至2030年Q1中國3500兆、美國2250兆。根據OpenRouter統計，今年8月初中國大模型週調用量約34.25兆，連續多週領先美國。
IBS創辦人Handel Jones指出，輝達自Hopper、Blackwell到Rubin，每百萬token計算成本由4.20美元降至0.12-0.01美元區間，但產業仍要把Token成本再降兩到三個數量級，才能支撐Agentic AI與超大規模推理。token暴增直接轉化為GPU、HBM、高速網路、先進封裝與電力基礎設施的同步擴產。
記憶體是本輪最緊環節。IBS預估，DRAM市場由2020年703億美元、2025年1425億美元，升至2026年6055億美元、2030年1.075兆美元、2035年1.844兆美元；顧能則預估2026年DRAM收入年增246.6%、NAND收入年增371.9%。
記憶體漲價主因在產能重配：三星、SK海力士、美光把成熟製程與部分DDR產能轉向HBM及企業級3D NAND，雲端廠商長單協議(LTA)鎖貨後，消費級SSD、行動與PC記憶體被迫承受剩餘產能溢價。
SK集團會長崔泰源稱客戶需求接近翻倍，2027年恐現史上最嚴重存儲短缺。根據IBS供需比數據，HBM約58%、DRAM離散產品約60%，NAND約74%—85%，均低於100%的供需平衡線。三星、SK海力士、美光已就2027年DRAM與HBM產能分配洽談，市場傳多數客戶最終配額僅為初始申請量60%—70%，但此類配貨比例應視為談判與渠道抽樣，不宜當作全行業確定值。
晶圓代工與先進封裝同步告急。IBS預估代工市場2025年1656億美元、2030年4711億美元、2035年破1兆；其中≤2奈米製程2030年約1774億美元。台積電2奈米進入量產、排期至2028年，3奈米與CoWoS持續滿載，今年資本支出上調至600—640億美元，約七至八成用於先進製程，其餘用於特殊製程、先進封裝與光罩。
IBS指出，≤2奈米加速器供需比由今年第一季89%降至2028年第一季73%，5/4/3奈米加速器同期由約74%—73%徘徊，智慧手機與CPU先進節點亦低於100%。相對地，28/22奈米 MCU、16/14/12奈米雜項及多數＞28奈米模擬、電源管理、影像感測均高於100%，成熟製程呈過剩。這種「先進製程缺、成熟製程鬆」的分化，使AI晶片擴量受制於前段製程、後段CoWoS與HBM三者同時補產。
資本開支正以軍備競賽速度放大。IBS指出，全球主要半導體企業資本支出由去年約1633億美元升至今年2584億美元、年增58.3%，其中台積電與三星各約620億美元，美光逾250億美元、SK海力士約310億美元，英特爾則趨穩於150-160億美元。
需求方面，IBS估算主要資料中心資本支出由去年5724億美元增至2026年1.1兆美元，亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟、Meta四家合計近7500億美元；TrendForce統計更納入甲骨文、字節跳動、騰訊、阿里、百度等九家雲端廠商，今年合計超8867億美元，並據此上修AI伺服器出貨增速至近31%。
但高支出反噬現金流：亞馬遜、谷歌、Meta近期自由現金流轉弱或部分轉負，穆迪示警六大科技巨頭AI投資推高資產負債表風險；IBS同時把「足夠半導體與電力」列為資料中心資本支出達標的主要挑戰。
總體來看，若IBS與顧能預測準確，半導體將由週期型產業轉為AI基礎設施型產業：記憶體從配角變戰略資源，先進製程與封裝決定GPU供給，電力與HBM配貨決定雲廠擴產上限。短期風險在價格跑在產能前——記憶體合約價、VLCC式運力與設備交期已反映短缺；中長期風險在2028年前後若資料中心資本支出走緩、DRAM新產能釋出，恐出現局部修正。
對供應鏈而言，HBM、2奈米製程、CoWoS、先進材料與設備是確定性最高的擴產方向；對下游消費電子與汽車晶片而言，則要防先進產能擠佔與成熟製程價格波動的雙向擠壓。
paras_en: IBS (International Business Strategies) now forecasts that the global semiconductor market will grow from $446.7 billion in 2020 to about $1.586 trillion in 2026, $2.585 trillion in 2030 and $4.678 trillion in 2035. IBS notes that the $1 trillion target originally expected for 2030 is being reached about four years early thanks to AI.

Research firm Gartner gives a similar total, estimating global semiconductor revenue this year at $1.6 trillion, up 92% from last year’s $809 billion. Memory revenue is about $837 billion, accounting for 54% of the total, and memory sales could break $1 trillion by 2027.

The key demand driver is inference tokens. IBS estimates that daily AI token consumption in China and the United States will rise from 34 trillion in China and 3 trillion in the U.S. in Q1 of last year to 3,500 trillion in China and 2,250 trillion in the U.S. by Q1 2030. OpenRouter data shows that in early August this year China’s large‑model weekly calls were about 34.25 trillion, staying ahead of the U.S. for several weeks.

IBS founder Handel Jones points out that Nvidia’s cost per million tokens has dropped from $4.20 to a range of $0.12‑$0.01 from the Hopper to Blackwell to Rubin architectures, but the industry still needs to cut token costs another two to three orders of magnitude to support agentic AI and massive‑scale inference. The token surge directly translates into synchronized expansion of GPUs, HBM, high‑speed networking, advanced packaging and power infrastructure.

Memory is the tightest link in this cycle. IBS projects the DRAM market to grow from $70.3 billion in 2020 and $142.5 billion in 2025 to $605.5 billion in 2026, $1.075 trillion in 2030 and $1.844 trillion in 2035; Gartner forecasts a 246.6% annual growth for DRAM and 371.9% for NAND in 2026.

Memory price increases are mainly due to capacity reallocation: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are shifting mature‑process and some DDR capacity to HBM and enterprise‑grade 3D NAND. After cloud providers lock in long‑term agreements (LTA), consumer SSD, mobile and PC memory are forced to bear the premium on the remaining capacity.

SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won says customer demand is nearly doubling and a historic storage shortage could hit in 2027. IBS supply‑demand ratios show HBM at about 58%, discrete‑product DRAM around 60%, NAND at 74‑85%—all below the 100% balance line. Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are already negotiating DRAM and HBM capacity allocations for 2027; the market hears that most customers will ultimately receive only 60‑70% of their initial requests, but such allocation ratios reflect negotiations and channel sampling rather than firm industry‑wide values.

Foundry and advanced‑packaging capacity are both tightening. IBS estimates the foundry market at $165.6 billion in 2025, $471.1 billion in 2030 and over $1 trillion in 2035, with sub‑2 nm processes accounting for about $177.4 billion in 2030. TSMC’s 2‑nm production is slated for volume ramp‑up by 2028, while 3‑nm and CoWoS remain fully booked. This year’s capex is raised to $60‑$64 billion, roughly 70‑80% of which is earmarked for advanced nodes, the rest for specialty processes, advanced packaging and photomasks.

IBS notes that the supply‑demand ratio for ≤2‑nm accelerators falls from 89% in Q1 2023 to 73% in Q1 2028, while 5/4/3‑nm accelerators hover around 73‑74% in the same period. Advanced‑node smartphones and CPUs are also below 100%. Conversely, 28/22‑nm MCUs, 16/14/12‑nm miscellaneous parts and most >28‑nm analog, power‑management and image‑sensor components are above 100%, indicating excess capacity in mature processes. This “advanced‑process shortage, mature‑process slack” split means AI chip scaling is constrained by front‑end nodes, back‑end CoWoS and HBM capacity simultaneously.

Capital spending is accelerating like an arms race. IBS says global semiconductor‑major capex rose from about $163.3 billion last year to $258.4 billion this year, a 58.3% year‑over‑year increase. TSMC and Samsung each plan roughly $62 billion, Micron over $25 billion, SK Hynix about $31 billion, and Intel steadies around $15‑$16 billion.

On the demand side, IBS estimates data‑center capex will climb from $572.4 billion last year to $1.1 trillion in 2026, with Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta together accounting for nearly $750 billion. TrendForce’s tally, which adds Oracle, ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba and Baidu, puts nine cloud players at over $886.7 billion this year and lifts the AI‑server shipment growth forecast to close to 31%.

However, high spending is hurting cash flow: Amazon, Google and Meta have recently seen weakening or even negative free cash flow, and Moody’s warns that AI investments by the six big tech firms are raising balance‑sheet risk. IBS also lists “sufficient semiconductors and power” as a primary challenge for meeting data‑center capex targets.

Overall, if IBS and Gartner’s forecasts hold, the semiconductor sector will shift from a cyclical industry to an AI‑infrastructure industry: memory moves from a supporting role to a strategic resource, advanced processes and packaging dictate GPU supply, and power and HBM allocations set the ceiling for cloud‑provider expansion. Short‑term risk lies in prices running ahead of capacity—memory contract prices, VLCC‑style freight capacity and equipment lead times already reflect shortages; medium‑ to long‑term risk emerges around 2028 if data‑center capex slows and new DRAM capacity comes online, potentially prompting a localized correction.

For the supply chain, HBM, 2‑nm processes, CoWoS, advanced materials and equipment are the most certain expansion avenues; downstream consumer electronics and automotive chips must guard against a two‑way squeeze from advanced‑node capacity crowding and mature‑process price volatility.

items.title: 〈國泰金經濟調查〉9月景氣樂觀情緒、股市風險偏好回升 仍憂民生物價影響通膨
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Economic Survey: September Optimism and Stock Market Risk Appetite Rebound, Yet Concerns Over Consumer Prices and Inflation
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(21)日發布2026年9月國民經濟信心調查結果，民眾景氣現況與展望樂觀指數雙雙反彈，大額消費意願同步走揚；受惠於AI基本面強勁支撐，台股樂觀情緒與風險偏好大幅回升。經濟成長方面，逾五成民眾預估全年經濟成長率將突破11%，展現對景氣的強勁信心；惟物價看法依然偏向嚴峻，過半民眾預期全年通膨高於2.5%，且近八成民眾認為一年後通膨率將持續超過2%。
國發會最新公布的7月景氣對策信號續呈紅燈，領先指標及同時指標續呈上升，景氣仍呈穩健成長。國泰金本月調查顯示，民眾的景氣樂觀指數反彈，其中景氣現況樂觀指數上升至14.8，展望樂觀指數上升至16.5。消費意願也同步改善，其中大額消費意願指數升至18.3，耐久財消費意願指數升至-3.9。

主計總處於2026年8月14日預估台灣2026年經濟成長率11.05%，通貨膨脹率2.07%。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於2026年經濟成長率的平均預期值為10.89%，有52%的民眾認為2026年經濟成長率會高於11%；而民眾對於2026年平均通膨預期值為2.51%，且有高達51%的民眾認為2026年通貨膨脹率會高於2.5%。相較於主計總處，民眾對於2026年的經濟成長預估與主計總處接近，但通膨預期依舊較高。
雖美伊談判持續，然美國通膨數據未大幅上升，且四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)續上修資本支出，財報優於預期支撐AI基本面，帶動台股走升。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於台股的樂觀指數回升至49.1，風險偏好指數上升至32.9。
關於民眾對一年後通貨膨脹率看法的調查，本月的調查結果顯示，79%的民眾預期一年以後通貨膨脹率大於2%，其中35%民眾預期將大於3%。另外，15%民眾覺得一年以後通貨膨脹率介於1%至2%。
針對民眾對未來一年物價漲跌判斷的主要因素，本月的調查結果顯示，有35%民眾認為未來一年物價漲跌主要受到日常消費價格影響(例如：外食、蔬菜水果、民生日用品等)，另有29%民眾認為進口原物料價格(例如：原油、鋼鐵等)，是未來一年物價漲跌判斷的主要因素。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) released the results of its September 2026 National Economic Confidence Survey today (21st). Both the public’s current‑economy optimism index and outlook optimism index rebounded, and willingness for large‑ticket purchases rose in tandem; buoyed by strong AI fundamentals, Taiwanese stock‑market optimism and risk appetite surged. Over half of respondents expect the annual economic growth rate to exceed 11%, showing strong confidence in the economy, but price expectations remain severe, with more than half anticipating inflation above 2.5% for the year and nearly 80% believing inflation will stay above 2% a year from now.

The National Development Council’s latest July economic‑policy signal remains red, with leading and coincident indicators continuing to rise, indicating steady growth. Cathay’s survey this month shows a rebound in the public’s economy‑optimism index, with the current‑economy optimism index climbing to 14.8 and the outlook optimism index to 16.5. Consumption willingness also improved, with the large‑ticket consumption index rising to 18.3 and the durable‑goods consumption index to –3.9.

The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics estimated on August 14, 2026 that Taiwan’s 2026 economic growth rate would be 11.05% and inflation 2.07%. This month’s survey shows the public’s average expected growth rate for 2026 at 10.89%, with 52% believing growth will exceed 11%; the average inflation expectation is 2.51%, and a record 51% think inflation will be above 2.5%. Compared with the official forecast, public growth expectations are close, but inflation expectations remain higher.

Despite ongoing US‑Iran talks, US inflation data has not risen sharply, and the four major cloud service providers (CSPs) have continued to raise capital‑expenditure plans, with earnings beating expectations and supporting AI fundamentals, driving the Taiwanese market higher. This month’s survey shows the public’s optimism index for the Taiwan stock market rebounded to 49.1, and the risk‑appetite index rose to 32.9.

Regarding expectations for inflation a year from now, this month’s survey shows 79% of respondents expect inflation to be above 2% in a year, with 35% expecting it to exceed 3%. Additionally, 15% think inflation a year ahead will be between 1% and 2%.

When asked what they consider the main driver of price changes over the next year, 35% of respondents said everyday consumer prices (e.g., dining out, fruits and vegetables, daily necessities) and 29% pointed to import raw‑material prices (e.g., crude oil, steel) as the primary factors.

items.title_en: Mid-Autumn Countdown: Don’t Rush to Flee! The Real “Unexploded Bomb” in Taiwan Stocks Is Just Three Words
paras: 最近很多人，一下擔心美國利率，一下怕油價上漲，現在又看到記憶體價格有雜音，又開始懷疑AI是不是要退燒。一看到手中股票下跌，就忍不住想：「是不是中秋要變盤了！該先跑了？」。若是如此，你恐怕將錯失第四季的台股大行情！
我們從技術面來看，台股只要守住 45,900 至 45,973 點的跳空缺口，隨著季線連續扣低，多頭均線即將呈現「萬佛朝宗」的大多頭排列。歷史數據更告訴我們，中秋過後的第四季上漲機率高達九成，在 AI 時代近三年節後平均漲幅更有 8%。所以，本周若因中秋連假出現賣壓，股價出現拉回不是讓你害怕，而是主力用心提供給你的黃金買點。
重點來了！該買什麼？江江的忠實鐵粉都知道，答案只有三個字「電、光、熱」！因為現在真正的問題，已經不是「AI有沒有需求」，而是：AI晶片愈來愈強，電夠不夠？資料跑得動嗎？熱散得掉嗎？這才是第四季台股值得注意的地方。
第一個「電」：AI愈強，吃電也愈兇
你家裡如果同時開冷氣、電鍋、烤箱、吹風機，偶爾是不是會跳電？AI資料中心其實也一樣。只是人家不是開幾台家電，而是一次塞進大量高功率AI伺服器。所以未來資料中心最大的問題之一就是：電從哪裡來？怎麼穩定供電？這也是為什麼800V電力架構開始受到市場注意。
核心指標廠：台達電(2308-TW) 作為電力升級的核心主導者，釋出了大量電力架構與備援訂單。
受惠潛力股：承接台達電大訂單的新盛力(4931-TW)；電力備援概念股-高力(8996-TW) 以及相關被動元件、二極體與功率元件廠 強茂(2481-TW)，都是電力升級潮下的真贏家。
第二個：光（CPO 矽光子與高速光傳輸）：未來三年的爆發主力
當晶片運算速度達到極限，傳統銅線傳輸就會變成嚴重的塞車瓶頸。台積電(2330-TW) 已經明確定義矽光子（CPO）為核心升級路徑，高層更公開預估 CPO 將在今年下半年啟動量產，2027 年矽光子在光收發模組的滲透率將突破 50%。
核心指標廠：包含 聯亞(3081-TW)、華星光(4979-TW)、上詮(3363-TW) 等光通訊關鍵廠商，已被台積電(2330-TW)認證為光連結驅動未來的核心要角。
第三個「熱」：AI晶片太熱，反而變成商機
最後一個「熱」，可能是一般投資人最容易理解的。手機用久了會發燙。電腦跑大型遊戲，也會發燙。那麼問題來了：如果一顆AI晶片比以前的晶片強很多，它會不會也更熱？答案當然是會。而且AI伺服器不是一台電腦而已，是大量高功耗晶片塞在一起。
所以以前吹風扇、散熱片就能解決的問題，現在開始需要更進階的水冷、液冷，甚至微流道散熱。這也是為什麼奇鋐(3017)、健策(3653)、雙鴻(3324)等散熱廠商受到市場關注。
最後，還有底層支撐：廠務、測試與指標記憶體
除了電光熱之外，廠務與測試更是真金白銀的明證。台積電(2330-TW)與 美光(MU-US) 擴產踩油門，讓廠務工程龍頭 漢唐(2404-TW)、亞翔(6139-TW) 訂單能見度排到 2028 年；晶圓測試大廠 京元電子(2449-TW) 也砸下重金大舉擴充 AI ASIC 與 GPU 測試設備，需求極度強勁。
至於記憶體，雖然本周有零星報價下修的雜音，但合約價與基本面並未惡化，聰明的資金應集中在華邦電(2344-TW) 與 南亞科(2408-TW) 等具備技術優勢的指標股上。

paras_en: Recently many people have been worrying about U.S. interest rates, fearing rising oil prices, and now hearing noise about memory prices, leading them to doubt whether AI is cooling off. When they see their stocks falling, they can’t help but think, “Is the market about to turn this Mid‑Autumn? Should I run now?” If so, you may miss the big Taiwan market rally in Q4!

From a technical perspective, as long as Taiwan’s market holds the gap between 45,900 and 45,973 points, the seasonal line will keep being pressed lower, and the bullish moving averages are about to form a massive “ten‑thousand‑Buddha” alignment. Historical data also shows that the probability of a rise in Q4 after Mid‑Autumn is as high as 90%, with an average post‑holiday gain of 8% in the AI era over the past three years. So if selling pressure appears during the Mid‑Autumn holiday this week and prices pull back, it’s not something to fear—it’s a golden buying opportunity deliberately offered by the main players.

Here’s the key! What should you buy? Jiang‑Jiang’s loyal fans know the answer is just three characters: “Electricity, Light, Heat.” The real issue now isn’t whether AI has demand, but whether the AI chips are getting stronger, is there enough power? Can the data run? Can the heat be dissipated? Those are the points to watch in Taiwan’s market for Q4.
First “Electricity”: The stronger the AI, the more power it devours.

If you run the air‑conditioner, rice cooker, oven and hair dryer all at once at home, you sometimes get a power outage, right? AI data centers face the same problem—but instead of a few home appliances, they pack a massive amount of high‑power AI servers. Thus, one of the biggest challenges for future data centers is: where does the electricity come from, and how to keep the supply stable? This is why the 800 V power‑grid architecture is drawing market attention.
Core indicator company: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) is the leading player in power‑upgrade solutions and has released a large volume of power‑architecture and backup orders.

Beneficiary stocks: New Sheng Li (4931‑TW), which takes on Delta’s big orders; backup‑power concept stock G‑Power (8996‑TW); and related passive component, diode and power‑device maker Strong‑Mao (2481‑TW) – all true winners in the power‑upgrade wave.
Second: Light (CPO silicon photonics and high‑speed optical transmission) – the main driver for the next three years.

When chip compute speeds hit their limits, traditional copper wiring becomes a severe bottleneck. TSMC (2330‑TW) has clearly defined silicon photonics (CPO) as a core upgrade path, and senior management publicly estimates CPO will start mass production in the second half of this year, with silicon‑photonic penetration in optical transceiver modules exceeding 50% by 2027.

Core indicator companies: Lian‑Ya (3081‑TW), Huaxing Light (4979‑TW), Shang‑Chuan (3363‑TW) and other key optical‑communication firms have been certified by TSMC (2330‑TW) as the core drivers of future optical links.
Third “Heat”: Over‑hot AI chips become a business opportunity.

The final “Heat” is probably the easiest for ordinary investors to grasp. Phones get hot after prolonged use. PCs heating up while running heavy games is familiar. The question is: if an AI chip is much more powerful than previous chips, will it also run hotter? The answer is yes. Moreover, an AI server isn’t just one computer; it’s a massive array of high‑power chips packed together.

Therefore, problems that used to be solved with fans or heat‑sinks now require advanced water‑cooling, liquid‑cooling, or even micro‑channel cooling. That’s why thermal‑solution companies such as Qihong (3017), Jiance (3653) and Shuang‑Hong (3324) are gaining market focus.
Finally, there’s the underlying support: fab operations, testing and benchmark memory.

Beyond electricity, light and heat, fab operations and testing are the real cash generators. TSMC (2330‑TW) and Micron (MU‑US) are accelerating capacity expansions, giving order visibility for fab‑engineering leaders Han‑Tang (2404‑TW) and Yaxiang (6139‑TW) out to 2028; wafer‑testing giant Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) is also pouring heavy investment into expanding AI ASIC and GPU testing equipment, reflecting extremely strong demand.

As for memory, although there were some scattered price‑cut rumors this week, contract prices and fundamentals have not deteriorated. Smart capital should focus on benchmark stocks with technical advantages such as Winbond (2344‑TW) and Nanya Technology (2408‑TW).
