items.title: 股債等多類資產年底或「同步」上漲？高盛：市場升息預期過度悲觀
paras: 高盛策略師認為，市場目前對全球主要央行升息路徑的定價過於悲觀，若通膨壓力隨油價回落而緩解，年底前可能出現股債等多類資產「同步」上漲的交易機會。
高盛研究部高級顧問Dominic Wilson與全球風險主管Josh Schiffrin於近日參加高盛Podcast節目時表示，市場目前預期本輪升息次數約達4次，但實際升息幅度可能僅有2次。
兩人均認為，油價走勢將是決定最終升息路徑的關鍵因素。若能源價格明顯回落，通膨預期可能降溫，進而為債券、股票等多類資產帶來同步走強的條件。
在能源價格大幅反彈、通膨預期升溫的背景下，市場對聯準會（Fed）未來升息幅度的預期持續升高。
Schiffrin表示，油價飆升是今年市場最大的意外之一，除了推升通膨預期，也讓市場對貨幣政策的定價更加激進。
他指出，市場已大幅反映一個完整的緊縮週期，預期升息約4次，但他認為最終升息次數不會達到這個水準；若必須提出具體預測，他傾向於2次。
Wilson也認同這項看法，並表示其基準情境是「10月再升息1次，之後長期暫停」。
Wilson指出，目前市場對聯準會、歐洲央行、日本及加拿大央行的升息幅度，均反映接近4次的預期，但實際升息力度可能低於市場預期。
他認為，若要在升息2次與6次之間做出判斷，升息2次的機率明顯較高。

長天期債券殖利率處高檔　油價回落成反轉關鍵

近期市場持續擔憂財政赤字、通膨黏著性及資本需求競爭等問題，但Schiffrin認為，債券市場已消化大量利空，投資吸引力正在提高。
他指出，10年期美國公債殖利率已升至5%以上，30年期實質殖利率也超過3%，這類票息與實質殖利率水準已是相當長時間未見的高點。
不過，Schiffrin表示，債券市場若要出現反轉，仍需要催化因素，而最可能的觸發點就是油價下跌。
Wilson則從結構面分析實質利率走高的原因。他表示，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動企業融資需求增加，加上政府財政赤字擴大，推升資本競爭壓力；另一方面，經濟成長仍具韌性，也使通膨降溫速度低於預期，進一步支撐較高的政策利率。
他認為，在企業融資需求與經濟成長前景出現實質變化前，長天期公債殖利率大幅下滑的空間有限。
不過，Wilson指出，若AI資本支出週期出現轉折，或經濟遭遇超出預期的下行衝擊，長天期殖利率仍可能明顯回落，但這兩種情境目前都不是高盛的基準預測。

美股展現韌性　年底「全資產上漲」仍待油價配合

Schiffrin表示，美股近期面對油價上漲、殖利率大幅走高及AI監管不確定性等多重壓力，表現卻明顯優於預期。
他認為，這表示市場具有相當韌性，部分反映當前大規模資本支出週期，以及實體經濟仍然強勁。
Wilson則指出，市場目前已反映相當程度的悲觀預期，包括升息4次、實質殖利率上升，以及油價突破每桶100美元等因素。因此，市場未來若出現緩解訊號，反而更容易出現價格修正。
他形容，當前是近期多頭投資者相對清晰的布局窗口，雖然條件不如7月底，但市場氛圍有相似之處。
針對年底前的交易方向，Schiffrin提出3項觀察：

美元可能受到聯準會相對鷹派立場及美國經濟領先優勢支撐而走強。
若美國期中選舉後油價下跌，市場可能出現「全資產上漲」行情，但前提是油價回落。
從中長期來看，超長天期公債目前偏高的實質殖利率仍具配置價值。


Wilson則表示，考慮到市場目前的升息定價，以及通膨可能透過多種途徑降溫，他對年底前利率定價出現修正的信心日益增加，並傾向透過低成本選擇權策略參與潛在行情。

items.title: 借貸成本增+政府融資需求飆！華爾街估短期美債發行規模將破1兆美元
items.title_en: Rising Borrowing Costs and Surging Government Funding Needs Prompt Wall Street to Forecast Short‑Term US Debt Issuance to Top $1 Trillion
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，隨著借貸成本攀升，多家華爾街投行預估，美國未來一年將發行約1兆美元的短期債務，以滿足不斷增長的政府融資需求。
《金融時報》報導，美國銀行預估，在截至2027年9月的新財年中，不計用於償還到期債務的新增借款規模約為1.07兆美元；摩根大通預計2027年短期國債發行規模約1.09兆美元，高盛預計為9610億美元。
短債發行增加之際，美國長期借款成本已升至2007年以來最高水平，財長貝森特此前希望透過擴大10年至30年期美債回購壓低長端利率。
根據美銀預估，到明年9月，美國未償短債規模將攀升至約8兆美元，佔可交易國債比例達24.3%；高盛估該比例明年為24.3%，2028年升至24.9%。這一水準接近欣冠疫情期間高點，而美國財政部借款諮詢委員會先前建議長期維持短債佔比約20%。
分析師表示，增加短債發行有助於降低目前融資成本，但也會提高未來再融資風險。美銀利率策略主管Mark Cabana表示，美國財政部正在平衡債市供需，但大量發行短債恐致利息支出「更大且更波動」。聯準會(Fed)今年來已購買大量短期國債，貨幣市場基金約8兆美元的資產規模也為短債提供需求支持。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that as borrowing costs climb, several Wall Street banks estimate the United States will issue about $1 trillion of short‑term debt over the next year to meet the growing demand for government financing.

The Financial Times cites that US banks project new borrowing, excluding debt repayments, of roughly $1.07 trillion for the fiscal year ending September 2027; JPMorgan forecasts short‑term Treasury issuance of about $1.09 trillion in 2027, while Goldman Sachs expects $961 billion.

As short‑term issuance rises, long‑term borrowing costs in the US have hit their highest level since 2007, and Treasury Secretary Yellen has previously sought to lower long‑end yields by expanding buybacks of 10‑ to 30‑year Treasuries.

According to Bank of America’s outlook, outstanding short‑term debt will climb to about $8 trillion by next September, representing 24.3% of the tradable Treasury market; Goldman Sachs estimates the same share at 24.3% next year, rising to 24.9% in 2028, a level near the pandemic‑era peak, while the Treasury borrowing advisory committee had earlier recommended a long‑run short‑term share around 20%.

Analysts say that increasing short‑term issuance can help lower current financing costs but raises future refinancing risk. Bank of America rate‑strategy head Mark Cabana notes the Treasury is balancing supply and demand in the bond market, but a flood of short‑term issues could make interest expenses “larger and more volatile.” The Fed has bought large amounts of short‑term Treasuries this year, and money‑market funds with about $8 trillion of assets also support demand for short‑term debt.

items.title: 華爾街看好AI「新世代雲端」！「這4股」獲優於大盤評級、AIaaS市場2034年上看4兆美元
items.title_en: Wall Street Bullish on AI "Next‑Gen Cloud"! These 4 Stocks Rated Outperform, AIaaS Market Could Reach $4 Trillion by 2034
paras: 隨著企業對人工智慧（AI）運算資源的需求持續攀升，專門提供AI算力的「新世代雲端」（Neocloud）業者逐漸受到華爾街關注。投資公司Northland Equity Capital Markets的資本市場分析師近日看好多家相關企業，並預期AI即服務（AIaaS）市場規模未來數年將大幅擴張，帶動算力供應商迎來成長機會。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Northland資本市場分析師Nehal Chokshi週五（18日）發布報告，首度針對4家新世代雲端業者展開研究，並給予Iris Energy (IREN-US) 、Boost Run (BRUN-US) 、ChronoScale (CHRN-US) 及SharonAI (SHAZ-US) 「優於大盤」評級。
Chokshi對Iris Energy設定每股99美元的目標價，相較週五收盤價46.68美元，潛在漲幅達112.05%；Boost Run、ChronoScale及SharonAI的目標價則分別為36美元、32美元及95美元。
美股週五交易中，Iris Energy收盤上漲7.36%至46.68美元，Boost Run與SharonAI分別上揚3.54%及1.47%，ChronoScale則上漲1.44%。
Northland看好新世代雲端產業，主要基於對AIaaS市場的成長預期。該服務讓企業與開發者透過網路使用AI能力，不必自行從頭建置複雜的AI系統。
Chokshi估計，AIaaS市場規模到了2034年可能擴大至約4兆美元。
這項預測遠高於基於輝達(NVDA-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 及超微半導體(AMD-US) 晶片的資料中心需求所推算的數據。該項預測預估AIaaS市場規模到2027年底將達8,530億美元。
AIaaS市場若大幅成長，將為AI算力供應商帶來利多。所謂AI算力，是指硬體晶片用於建置、訓練及運作AI模型所需的基礎運算能力。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 則是該領域的先行業者之一。
Northland指出，自2025年12月以來，AI算力的每小時租賃價格已上漲約33%。然而，超大規模雲端服務商的收費仍約為新世代雲端業者的3倍，顯示市場價格仍有進一步上調的空間。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 網路服務（AWS）及微軟(MSFT-US) 均屬超大規模雲端服務商。
Chokshi表示，只要市場供給持續低於需求，新世代雲端現貨市場的價格上漲動能預料將延續，合約價格也可能隨之走高。
他進一步指出，已建立或正在發展自有軟體生態系的新世代雲端業者，在當前價格環境下尤其具備優勢。
透過整合軟體，新世代雲端業者不必侷限於提供原始算力，還能加入管理及最佳化功能，縮小與超大規模雲端服務商之間的差距，並可能讓客戶更長期地使用其平台。
CoreWeave、Nebius(YNDX-US) 、Iris Energy及ChronoScale均被列為具備相關發展方向的企業。
其中，Iris Energy收購雲端基礎設施與軟體公司Mirantis後，Chokshi認為，該公司已具備發展軟體差異化AIaaS服務的明確路徑。
Northland此次針對Iris Energy的正面評價，並非華爾街近期首度看好該公司。
摩根大通分析師Richard Choe上週一將Iris Energy股票評級從「減碼」連升兩級至「加碼」，並將目標價由46美元上調至65美元。
Choe指出，Iris Energy已轉型為頂級新世代雲端業者。這家原本專注於比特幣挖礦的公司，近年將業務重心轉向AI運算服務，在客戶拓展方面已展現動能；此外，與輝達建立策略合作關係，也為其AI雲端服務業務增添市場認可度。
根據FactSet調查的19家機構資料，Iris Energy目前平均評級為「買進」，平均目標價為82.54美元。
paras_en: As corporate demand for artificial‑intelligence (AI) computing power continues to climb, providers of AI‑focused "next‑gen cloud" services are drawing Wall Street attention. Capital‑markets analysts at Northland Equity Capital Markets have recently taken a positive view on several such firms and expect the AI‑as‑a‑Service (AIaaS) market to expand dramatically over the next few years, creating growth opportunities for compute providers.

According to Barron’s, Northland analyst Nehal Chokshi released a report on Friday the 18th that, for the first time, examines four next‑gen cloud companies and assigns them an "outperform" rating: Iris Energy (IREN‑US), Boost Run (BRUN‑US), ChronoScale (CHRN‑US) and SharonAI (SHAZ‑US).

Chokshi set a target price of $99 per share for Iris Energy, implying a potential upside of 112.05% from Friday’s close of $46.68. The target prices for Boost Run, ChronoScale and SharonAI are $36, $32 and $95 respectively.
In Friday’s U.S. trading, Iris Energy closed up 7.36% at $46.68, while Boost Run and SharonAI rose 3.54% and 1.47% respectively, and ChronoScale gained 1.44%.

Northland is optimistic on the next‑gen cloud sector mainly because of its expectations for AIaaS growth. The service lets enterprises and developers access AI capabilities over the internet without having to build complex AI systems from scratch.
Chokshi estimates the AIaaS market could swell to roughly $4 trillion by 2034.

That forecast far exceeds estimates based on data‑center demand for chips from Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US). The same projection puts the AIaaS market at $853 billion by the end of 2027.

If AIaaS expands rapidly, it will be a tailwind for AI compute suppliers. "AI compute" refers to the hardware needed to build, train and run AI models. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) is one of the early players in this space.

Northland notes that, since December 2025, hourly rental rates for AI compute have risen about 33%. However, ultra‑large cloud providers still charge roughly three times what next‑gen cloud firms charge, indicating room for further price increases.
Amazon (AMZN‑US) Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) are both ultra‑large cloud providers.
Chokshi says that as long as supply remains below demand, price‑upward momentum in the spot market for next‑gen cloud compute is likely to continue, and contract prices could rise as well.
He adds that next‑gen cloud firms that have built or are developing their own software ecosystems enjoy a particular advantage in the current pricing environment.

By integrating software, next‑gen cloud providers are not limited to raw compute; they can add management and optimization features, narrowing the gap with ultra‑large clouds and potentially encouraging longer‑term platform usage by customers.
CoreWeave, Nebius (YNDX‑US), Iris Energy and ChronoScale are all cited as companies pursuing these development paths.
After Iris Energy’s acquisition of cloud‑infrastructure and software company Mirantis, Chokshi believes the firm now has a clear path to differentiated, software‑driven AIaaS offerings.
Northland’s positive view on Iris Energy is not Wall Street’s first recent endorsement of the company.
JPMorgan analyst Richard Choe upgraded Iris Energy’s rating from "underweight" two notches to "overweight" last Monday and raised the target price from $46 to $65.

Choe notes that Iris Energy has transformed into a top‑tier next‑gen cloud player. Originally a Bitcoin‑mining company, it has shifted its focus to AI compute services, showing momentum in customer acquisition, and its strategic partnership with Nvidia adds market credibility to its AI cloud business.
FactSet’s survey of 19 institutional investors shows Iris Energy currently carries an average rating of "Buy" with an average target price of $82.54.

items.title: 10月股市「崩盤魔咒」是迷思？分析：反而是逢低布局機會
items.title_en: Is the October Stock‑Market “Crash Curse” a Myth? Analysis: It May Actually Be a Buying‑the‑Dip Opportunity
paras: 10月向來被視為美股崩盤高風險月份，但分析人士指出，投資人對「10月魔咒」的擔憂，反而可能壓低市場表現，創造逢低布局機會。歷史數據顯示，標普500指數自1957年以來，有93%的年份在10月低點後上漲至年底，平均漲幅達7.4%，幾乎是其他11個月份平均漲幅的2倍；研究亦發現，10月並不存在特殊的股市崩盤風險。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，分析認為，市場情緒可能是造成這項季節性現象的關鍵因素。
報導以一群專注於那斯達克市場、由數十名股市擇時操作者組成的樣本為例，觀察他們建議的平均股票曝險比率，因為這部分股市對散戶投資人情緒的變化尤其敏感。
分析顯示，自2000年以來，10月對這部分市場的平均股票曝險比率，僅略高於其他11個月份的一半，分別為13.6%與26.1%。因此，股市自10月低點反彈的現象，正是逆向分析的經典例證。

研究顯示10月並無特殊崩盤風險

更值得注意的是，兩項研究指出，投資人10月降低股票曝險，主要與市場情緒有關，而非當月存在特殊的基本面風險。
其中，哈佛大學經濟學與金融學教授Xavier Gabaix及其共同研究者建立了一套複雜模型，用以估算股市在10月的任何一天出現極端單日崩盤的機率。
研究顯示，任何一個10月出現類似1987年股災、道瓊工業指數單日重挫22.6%的崩盤，機率僅為0.06%；至於出現類似1929年股災、單日下跌12.8%的情況，機率則為0.30%。
同時，Gabaix亦表示，這些極低的崩盤機率適用於所有月份，10月並沒有特殊之處，因此股市歷史上最嚴重的兩次崩盤恰好發生在10月，幾乎可以確定只是巧合。
他表示：「就我們所知，沒有特別理由顯示10月的崩盤機率會高於其他月份。」
另一項顯示股市崩盤風險目前並未升高的研究，則是由哈佛大學的Robin Greenwood與Andrei Shleifer，以及香港大學的Yang You共同進行。他們並未聚焦於單日股市崩盤的發生機率，而是著眼於股市在2年內下跌40%的可能性。
State Street Markets在徵詢Greenwood的意見後，以這項研究為基礎，進一步建立了該公司稱為「美國市場泡沫預測」的指標。根據這項預測的最新更新結果，未來2年美股下跌40%的機率，與歷史平均值相比並無顯著差異。
報導總結稱，整體而言，若投資人僅因10月即將到來，便擔心未來幾週可能爆發股市崩盤，現有研究並不支持這項憂慮。
儘管股市仍可能走跌，但單憑月份進入10月，並不足以認定市場面臨更高的崩盤風險。
paras_en: October has long been viewed as a high‑risk month for a US stock‑market crash, but analysts say investors’ worries about the “October curse” may actually depress market performance and create buying‑the‑dip opportunities. Historical data show that since 1957 the S&P 500 has risen after its October lows in 93% of years, gaining an average of 7.4% by year‑end – roughly twice the average gain of the other eleven months – and research also finds no special crash risk in October.
According to MarketWatch, analysts believe market sentiment may be the key driver of this seasonal pattern.

The report cites a sample of dozens of market‑timing practitioners who focus on the Nasdaq, observing the average equity‑exposure ratios they recommend, because that segment of the market is especially sensitive to retail investor sentiment shifts.

Analysis shows that since 2000 the average equity‑exposure ratio for this segment in October is only slightly higher than the average for the other eleven months – 13.6% versus 26.1% – making the post‑October‑low rebound a classic contrarian example.

Research shows October carries no special crash risk. More notably, two studies find that investors lower equity exposure in October mainly due to sentiment, not because of any unique fundamental risk that month.
Harvard economics and finance professor Xavier Gabaix and co‑authors have built a sophisticated model to estimate the probability of an extreme single‑day crash on any day in October.
The study finds the chance of a crash comparable to the 1987 crash – a 22.6% one‑day drop in the Dow – is only 0.06%, while the probability of a 1929‑type crash – a 12.8% one‑day fall – is 0.30%.

Gabaix also notes that these extremely low crash probabilities apply to all months; October is no different, and the fact that the two worst crashes in history happened in October is almost certainly a coincidence.
He says, “As far as we know, there is no particular reason to think the crash probability in October is higher than in other months.”

Another study showing that crash risk is not currently elevated was conducted by Harvard’s Robin Greenwood and Andrei Shleifer together with Hong Kong University’s Yang You. Rather than focusing on single‑day crash probabilities, they examined the likelihood of a 40% market decline over a two‑year horizon.

After consulting Greenwood, State Street Markets used this research to develop its “U.S. Market Bubble Forecast” indicator. The latest update of that forecast shows the probability of a 40% drop in US equities over the next two years is not significantly different from the historical average.
The report concludes that, overall, existing research does not support the concern that the mere approach of October should make investors fear an imminent market crash in the coming weeks.
While markets can still decline, simply entering the month of October is insufficient to deem the market facing a higher crash risk.

items.title: 減持輝達？黃仁勳被代扣4.57萬股繳稅 4高管也被扣逾11.5萬股 財務長先套現765萬美元
items.title_en: Selling Nvidia? Jensen Huang Withheld 45,728 Shares for Taxes, Four Executives Also Had Over 115,000 Shares Withheld, CFO Cashes Out $7.65 million
paras: 最新文件顯示，包括執行長黃仁勳在內的5名輝達高層合計出售16萬股公司股票用以繳稅。
根據輝達周六(18日)向美國證交會(SEC)提交的一份Form 4文件，由於限制性股票單位(RSU)歸屬產生稅款而被動代扣股票，黃仁勳被代扣4萬5728股普通股，每股計價212.170萬美元，對應價值約970萬美元。
文件指出，這些股份由輝達扣留，用於滿足黃仁勳因RSU歸屬而產生的稅務義務，並非公開市場出售。
除黃仁勳以外，輝達財務長Colette Kress、營運長Debora Shoquist、總法律顧問兼秘書Timothy Teter及會計漲Scott Gawel也在上周三(16日)進行類似的股份代扣，四人代扣股份分別為40747股、350088、35738股和25388股和25388股。
不過，不同於其他四人，Kress上周四(17日)也透過公開市場實際出售，分三筆賣出共34918股，依據其於2026年6月16日制定的Rule 10b5-1交易計畫執行，合計交易金額約764.9萬美元。
輝達Form 4文件也揭露了一項不同性質的股份變動。黃仁勳夫婦的Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Living Trust信託上周四無償轉讓43.8萬股輝達股票，其中29.2萬股捐贈給The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation基金會，另有14.6萬股轉入一個捐贈者建議基金(donor-advised fundor-advised fundor)。
上周五(18日)，輝達收漲1.34%至每股222.27美元，總市值5.36兆美元。
paras_en: The latest filings show that five Nvidia senior executives, including CEO Jensen Huang, collectively sold 160,000 shares of company stock to cover taxes.

According to a Form 4 filed by Nvidia with the SEC on Saturday (the 18th), Huang had 45,728 shares of common stock withheld to satisfy tax liabilities arising from the vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs), each valued at $212.170, for a total approximate value of $9.7 million.
The filing notes that these shares were retained by Nvidia to meet Huang’s tax obligations from RSU vesting and were not sold on the open market.

In addition to Huang, Nvidia’s chief financial officer Colette Kress, chief operating officer Debora Shoquist, general counsel and secretary Timothy Teter, and accountant Scott Gawel also had similar share withholdings last Wednesday (the 16th), with the four executives having 40,747, 350,088, 35,738 and 25,388 shares respectively withheld.

Unlike the other four, Kress also sold shares on the open market on Thursday (the 17th), disposing of a total of 34,918 shares in three transactions under her Rule 10b5‑1 trading plan dated June 16 2026, for an aggregate proceeds of about $7.649 million.

The Form 4 also disclosed a different type of share movement: the Jen‑Hsun & Lori Huang Living Trust transferred 438,000 Nvidia shares without consideration last Thursday, of which 292,000 shares were donated to the Jen‑Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation and another 146,000 shares were placed into a donor‑advised fund.
On Friday (the 18th), Nvidia rose 1.34% to $222.27 per share, giving the company a market value of $5.36 trillion.

items.title: 《大賣空》原型質疑AI放緩論背後「有盤算」！稱OpenAI、Anthropic成AI產業「脆弱環節」
items.title_en: The ‘Big Short’ Inspiration Questions the Motives Behind Calls to Slow AI, Calling OpenAI and Anthropic the Industry’s ‘Achilles Heels’
paras: 電影《大賣空》原型、曾準確預測2008年房市崩盤的投資人Steve Eisman表示，他並不擔心所謂的「機器人末日」，反而認為，部分人工智慧（AI）業者大肆警告技術可能導致災難，背後可能存在特定利益考量。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Eisman近日接受訪問時指出，頂尖AI實驗室近期呼籲放慢技術開發速度，可能是因為這些企業意識到自身缺乏足以抵禦競爭的「護城河」，因此試圖製造危機感。
近期，AI可能引發全球性災難的討論持續升溫。前Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon公開辭職，便是出於對AI開發商未充分重視安全問題的疑慮。
儘管外界對AI是否可能導致末日情境仍存在不同看法，但Eisman認為，他認為這波恐慌背後存在特定目的。
他認為，這些企業希望製造一場危機，促使政府推出監管措施，之後再設法操控監管制度，建立由兩家企業主導的雙寡頭市場，藉此取代過去曾為其商業模式築起屏障的護城河。
Eisman並指出，AI產業過去透過最大化模型使用量來推動成長的「tokenmaxxing」時代已經結束，開放權重模型正逐步搶占市場，讓相關企業感到不安。
近期也有其他業者指出，AI產業的高速擴張正面臨挑戰。Citadel Securities日前表示，成本上升已讓AI交易熱潮面臨現實考驗，部分市場動能因此受到抑制。
Eisman透露，他近期已降低自身對AI產業的投資曝險。幾週前，他曾對AI市場提出疑慮，並將OpenAI與Anthropic形容為AI交易中的「阿基里斯腱」，即整個產業鏈的脆弱環節。
他表示，OpenAI與Anthropic在整個AI產業鏈中占據相當大的比重，若其中一家出現問題，可能導致整條產業鏈受到嚴重衝擊。
值得注意的是，在這兩家公司之中，Eisman認為OpenAI的狀況較為脆弱。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近期呼籲放慢AI開發速度，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及SpaceX執行長馬斯克也表達過類似觀點。
考慮到到Anthropic正準備進行首次公開募股（IPO），Eisman也對Amodei提出相關呼籲的動機抱持懷疑。
Eisman說：「當你說我們應該放慢腳步，因為事情很危險時，我的回應是：『真的嗎？那就延後你的IPO。』」然而，他強調，自己沒有聽說過有人在談延後IPO或暫緩募資。
paras_en: Investor Steve Eisman, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short” who accurately predicted the 2008 housing market collapse, says he is not worried about a so‑called “robot apocalypse.” Instead, he believes that some AI firms’ loud warnings that the technology could cause disaster may be driven by specific interests.

According to Business Insider, Eisman said in a recent interview that the top AI labs’ recent calls to slow the pace of development may be because these companies realize they lack a defensible “moat” against competition, and are therefore trying to manufacture a sense of crisis.

Discussion about AI potentially triggering a global catastrophe has been heating up. Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned, citing concerns that AI developers were not taking safety issues seriously enough.
Although opinions differ on whether AI could lead to an apocalyptic scenario, Eisman thinks there is a specific purpose behind the current wave of panic.

He argues that these companies want to create a crisis that will prompt governments to introduce regulation, after which they can try to shape the regulatory framework to create a duopoly led by two firms, thereby replacing the moat that previously protected their business models.

Eisman points out that the era of “token‑maxxing,” where the AI industry drove growth by maximizing model usage, is over, and open‑weight models are gradually taking market share, unsettling incumbent firms.

Other players have also noted that the rapid expansion of the AI sector is facing headwinds. Citadel Securities recently said rising costs are putting the AI trading boom to the test, dampening some market momentum.

Eisman disclosed that he has recently reduced his exposure to AI investments. A few weeks ago he voiced doubts about the AI market and described OpenAI and Anthropic as the “Achilles heels” of AI trading – the fragile links in the industry chain.
He said OpenAI and Anthropic occupy a very large share of the AI value chain, and a problem at either company could cause a severe shock to the entire industry.
It is worth noting that, of the two, Eisman considers OpenAI to be the more vulnerable.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has recently called for a slowdown in AI development, and both OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk have expressed similar views.
Given that Anthropic is preparing for its initial public offering, Eisman is skeptical of Amodei’s motives for making the call.

Eisman said, “When you say we should slow down because things are dangerous, my response is: ‘Really? Then postpone your IPO.’” However, he emphasized that he has not heard anyone actually discuss delaying an IPO or pausing fundraising.

items.title: 華爾街估Fed今年再升息2次 甚至一路升到「經濟出事」
items.title_en: Wall Street Predicts Fed Will Raise Rates Twice More This Year, Possibly All the Way to an "Economic Crisis"
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US) 認為，聯準會已展開新一波升息循環，直到今年底前的每場會議都可能升息。
美銀在最新報告指出，繼9月份調升1碼後，預期聯準會今年還會再升息兩次。目前市場定價最有可能的情形是2026年再升息一次，主要聚焦於12月的利率決策會議。
不過，美銀提出市場可能低估升息次數的兩項理由。首先，美國經濟依然強勁，支持通膨可能持續居高不下的看法。通膨仍具黏性，過去兩個月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率均維持在3.4%。
升息反成華許政治利多
其次，美銀指出，儘管美國總統川普一再要求聯準會降息，但對聯準會主席華許而言，升息實際上似乎已變得「有利於政治操作」。
油價上漲與美國財政部的債券回購計畫，引發投資人對通膨進一步升溫的疑慮。聯準會升息有助於壓抑長期債券殖利率，而10年期與30年期美債殖利率先前大幅攀升，已開始對股價構成壓力。
因此，美銀認為，聯準會此時採取鷹派立場，反而有利金融市場，也有助提升華許的政策公信力。
美銀美國經濟學家巴夫（Aditya Bhave）在報告中寫道：「幾個月前，聯準會升息在政治上看來仍充滿挑戰，但如今愈來愈像是華許建立個人政治遺產的機會。」
有助擺脫政治干預疑慮
談到9月升息時，巴夫進一步表示，這次升息首先緩解了外界對華許缺乏政治獨立性的疑慮，若進一步升息，將能徹底終結相關爭論。
另一方面，華許在接任聯準會主席後僅第三次會議便決定升息，不僅可將自己與既有通膨問題切割，未來數月若通膨降溫，也能將成果歸於其政策。
巴夫預測，聯準會在2026年底前連續升息三次後，政策調整將進入一段較長時間的暫停期。
升息循環恐才剛開始
文藝復興總體經濟研究（Renaissance Macro Research）經濟學主管杜塔（Neil Dutta）也表示，華許的鷹派程度可能比部分投資人預期的還要深。
杜塔指出，儘管華許一向反感前瞻指引，但他在上週三的會議上仍透露出其對貨幣政策的鷹派立場。例如，華許警告高商品價格暗示了通膨壓力，他同時提及將「更即時」地讓通膨率重返2%，並將該次升息形容為僅是撤除「一劑寬鬆政策」。
這讓杜塔得出結論，聯準會的升息循環「離結束還早，更接近開端」。他並補充：「華許很有可能會持續升息，直到經濟出現狀況為止。」
他回顧華許先前在聯準會任職的經歷指出，華許過去就曾為了達成雙重使命中的通膨目標，而願意放任勞動市場下滑，他目前的所作所為顯示，他願意再次這麼做。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) believes the Federal Reserve has started a new cycle of rate hikes, with each meeting through the end of the year potentially resulting in a hike.

In its latest report, BofA notes that after the one‑basis‑point increase in September, the Fed is expected to raise rates twice more this year. The market’s most likely pricing scenario is a further hike in 2026, focused on the December policy meeting.

However, BofA cites two reasons the market may be underestimating the number of hikes. First, the U.S. economy remains strong, supporting the view that inflation could stay elevated. Inflation remains sticky, with the CPI annual rate holding at 3.4% for the past two months.
Rate hikes turn into a political boon for Powell
Second, BofA points out that although former President Trump repeatedly urged the Fed to cut rates, for Chair Jerome Powell the hikes appear to have become "politically advantageous."

Rising oil prices and the Treasury’s bond‑buyback program have sparked investor concerns that inflation could heat up further. Rate hikes help suppress long‑term bond yields, and the recent sharp rise in 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields has already begun to pressure equity prices.
Thus, BofA argues that the Fed’s hawkish stance at this moment actually benefits financial markets and bolsters Powell’s policy credibility.

BofA U.S. economist Aditya Bhave wrote in the report: "A few months ago, rate hikes still seemed politically challenging for the Fed, but now they increasingly look like an opportunity for Powell to build a personal political legacy."
Helps allay concerns about political interference
Discussing the September hike, Bhave added that the move first eased doubts about Powell’s political independence, and further hikes could finally put the controversy to rest.

Moreover, Powell’s decision to raise rates at his third meeting as Fed chair not only distances him from existing inflation problems, but if inflation cools in the coming months, he can claim credit for the improvement.
Bhave forecasts that after three consecutive hikes by the end of 2026, the Fed will enter a relatively long pause in policy adjustments.
Rate‑hike cycle may have only just begun
Neil Dutta, head of economics at Renaissance Macro Research, also said Powell’s hawkishness could be deeper than some investors expect.

Dutta noted that although Powell traditionally dislikes forward guidance, he signaled a hawkish stance at last Wednesday’s meeting. For example, Powell warned that high commodity prices signal inflation pressure, said he would bring inflation back to 2% "more promptly," and described the hike as merely removing "one dose of accommodative policy."

This led Dutta to conclude that the Fed’s rate‑hike cycle "is far from over, closer to its beginning." He added, "Powell is very likely to keep raising rates until the economy shows signs of trouble."

He recalled Powell’s earlier tenure at the Fed, noting that Powell previously allowed labor‑market weakness to achieve the dual mandate’s inflation target, and his current actions suggest he is willing to do so again.

items.title: 美債殖利率恐引發市場風暴！「債券之王」警告：利率持續走高將放大AI與私人信貸風險
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields May Spark Market Storm! The "Bond King" Warns Rising Rates Could Amplify AI and Private Credit Risks
paras: 有「債券之王」之稱的DoubleLine Capital投資長Jeff Gundlach警告，投資人應提防利率進一步攀升。儘管美國公債殖利率近期已升至近20年高點，但他認為，利率仍可能大幅走高，並對金融市場造成重大衝擊。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Gundlach近日在曼哈頓一場活動中分享最新市場展望時表示，若利率「真的開始上升」，美國經濟可能因此陷入衰退，甚至引發一波企業倒閉潮。
他並未明確說明利率須升至多高或以多快速度攀升，才會觸發上述風險。不過，他提出一種可能情境：長天期公債殖利率突破6%，迫使美國財政部進一步加大干預力度，以平抑市場波動。
美國財政部近期才宣布，將買回總值60億美元的長天期公債，但Gundlach認為，利率走高最終可能在市場引發「某些重大變化」，尤其是當融資成本上升，與AI交易及私人信貸市場的脆弱性相互作用時，風險可能進一步擴大。
Gundlach表示：「我們看起來就像正朝著某種碰撞局面前進，違約事件將開始快速、大量地出現。」
在全球政府債券遭拋售之際，各國債券殖利率持續走高。美國10年期公債殖利率近期突破5%這項重要關卡。
這個被視為債券市場心理關鍵的水準，反映投資人對油價上漲及其通膨影響感到不安，並因此將更高的利率納入定價。
美國財政部推出公債買回計畫後，投資人的情緒也未獲得太大安撫，殖利率反而在計畫宣布當天跳升。市場擔心的是，這項措施並未處理目前最受關注的財政問題。
Gundlach表示，考慮到通膨及油價面臨上行風險，殖利率可能持續逐步攀升。他指出，市場本週或許因聯準會（Fed）展現抑制通膨的意願而受到鼓舞，但各國很快將需要補充石油儲備；這些儲備在伊朗戰爭期間已被大量動用。
他認為，新增需求可能進一步推升油價，尤其當通膨預期失去錨定、消費者因預期價格上漲而開始囤積商品時，可能形成自我實現的通膨螺旋。
Gundlach指出，聯準會可以透過升息壓抑通膨，但利率走高也會增加政府與民間債務的利息支出，進而加重金融市場壓力。
他推測，高利率最終可能與經濟其他領域的脆弱性相互作用，包括市場對AI企業估值過高的疑慮，以及私人信貸市場近期浮現的壓力跡象。
在形容市場走勢時，Gundlach表示：「長天期美國公債殖利率最沒有阻力的方向是上升。」
Gundlach因曾預測次級房貸危機而廣為人知。他表示，目前正考慮避開股票。今年稍早，他也曾警告通膨可能升溫，並建議投資人增加現金、商品、黃金及其他實體資產在投資組合中的配置。
paras_en: DoubleLine Capital chief investment officer Jeff Gundlach, known as the "Bond King," warned investors to guard against further rate hikes. Although U.S. Treasury yields have recently risen to near‑20‑year highs, he believes rates could still climb sharply and deliver a major shock to financial markets.
According to Business Insider, Gundlach said at a Manhattan event that if rates "really start to rise," the U.S. economy could slip into recession and even trigger a wave of corporate bankruptcies.

He did not specify exactly how high or how fast rates would need to go to trigger those risks, but he outlined a possible scenario: long‑term Treasury yields breaking above 6%, forcing the Treasury to step up intervention to calm market volatility.

The Treasury recently announced a buy‑back of $6 billion of long‑term Treasuries, but Gundlach thinks higher rates could eventually cause "some major changes" in the market, especially as rising financing costs interact with the fragility of AI trading and private‑credit markets, magnifying risk.
Gundlach said, "It looks like we are heading toward some kind of collision scenario, and default events will start to appear quickly and in large numbers."
As governments worldwide sell off bonds, yields are climbing across the board. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield recently breached the key 5% threshold.
That level is seen as a psychological benchmark for the bond market, reflecting investors' unease about rising oil prices and their inflationary impact, prompting higher rates to be priced in.

Even after the Treasury launched its buy‑back program, investor sentiment was not soothed; yields actually spiked on the day the plan was announced. Markets worry the measure does not address the most pressing fiscal concerns.

Gundlach said that, given upside risks to inflation and oil prices, yields could keep climbing gradually. He noted the market might be buoyed this week by the Fed's willingness to curb inflation, but countries will soon need to replenish oil reserves that were heavily drawn down during the Iran war.

He believes new demand could push oil prices higher, especially if inflation expectations become unanchored and consumers start stockpiling goods in anticipation of price hikes, potentially creating a self‑fulfilling inflation spiral.
Gundlach pointed out that the Fed can raise rates to suppress inflation, but higher rates also increase interest costs for both government and private debt, adding pressure to financial markets.

He speculated that high rates could eventually interact with vulnerabilities in other parts of the economy, including concerns that AI company valuations are overly lofty and emerging stress signs in the private‑credit market.
Describing the market trajectory, Gundlach said, "The path of least resistance for long‑term U.S. Treasury yields is upward."

Gundlach became widely known for predicting the sub‑prime mortgage crisis. He said he is now considering staying out of equities. Earlier this year he warned that inflation could heat up again and advised investors to increase allocations to cash, commodities, gold and other tangible assets.

items.title: 傳統豪華品牌也撐不住了 從BBA到二線豪華都在降
items.title_en: Even Traditional Luxury Brands Can’t Hold On Anymore, From BBA to Second‑Tier Luxury All Cutting Prices
paras: 有車型售價接近腰斬，傳統豪華品牌售價集體「失守」，「沃爾沃S90從（人民幣，下同）40萬降到22萬」的詞條20日（周日）在中國社交媒體平台衝上了熱搜。
沃爾沃S90是沃爾沃旗下一款中大型轎車，官方指導價格為40.69萬元起，但從第三方平台上的經銷商報價來看，入門版目前價格為22.99萬元，較官方指導價下降17.7萬元，降價幅度約43.50%，接近腰斬。
沃爾沃S90並不是孤例，多款車型的經銷商報價降價幅度都在30%以上，尤其是與沃爾沃S90同級的傳統豪華品牌中大型轎車。
從與沃爾沃S90的BBA同級車型來看，奧迪A6L部分款型在北京經銷商報價為28.16萬元，較官方指導價下降17.33萬元，降價幅度約38.10%。
近年來傳統豪車降價的新聞一波接一波，從BBA到二線豪華品牌，從轎車到SUV，幾乎無一倖免，整個傳統豪華車陣營的價格體系正在經歷一場鬆動。
《車東西》指出，傳統豪華車型價格體系崩塌，是多重原因同時擠壓的結果。
最直接的寒意來自車市大盤整體收縮。根據乘聯分會發布的數據，今年8月全中國乘用車零售為154.1萬輛，較一年前驟降23.6%。
新能源車滲透率達到65.2%歷史新高，也讓以燃油車為主的傳統豪華品牌雪上加霜。
乘聯分會的數據顯示，8月燃油車零售較去年同期銳減40%，其中純燃油車狂降45%，燃油車中主流合資下降40%，豪華品牌下滑33%。
paras_en: Some models are seeing prices cut almost in half, with traditional luxury brands collectively “losing ground”. The headline “Volvo S90 drops from 400,000 yuan to 220,000 yuan” trended on Chinese social media on the 20th (Sunday).

The Volvo S90 is a mid‑size sedan under the Volvo brand, officially priced from 406,900 yuan. However, dealer quotes on third‑party platforms show the entry‑level version now costs 229,900 yuan, a drop of 177,000 yuan from the official guide price, roughly a 43.5% reduction, close to a halving of the price.
The Volvo S90 is not an isolated case; many models are seeing dealer‑quoted price cuts of over 30%, especially mid‑size sedans from traditional luxury brands that compete with the S90.
Looking at BBA models comparable to the Volvo S90, some Audi A6L trims in Beijing are quoted at 281,600 yuan, down 173,300 yuan from the official guide price, a reduction of about 38.1%.

In recent years, news of price cuts for traditional luxury cars has been coming in waves—from BBA to second‑tier luxury brands, from sedans to SUVs, almost none are spared. The entire pricing structure of the traditional luxury car camp is undergoing a loosening.
According to “Car Things”, the collapse of the traditional luxury car pricing system is the result of multiple pressures converging at once.

The most immediate chill comes from a overall contraction in the auto market. Data released by the China Passenger Car Association shows that retail sales of passenger cars in China in August this year were 1.541 million units, a sharp 23.6% drop from a year earlier.
The penetration rate of new‑energy vehicles hit a historic high of 65.2%, further squeezing traditional luxury brands that rely mainly on gasoline cars.

Data from the China Passenger Car Association indicates that August retail sales of gasoline cars fell sharply by 40% year‑on‑year, with pure gasoline models plunging 45%, mainstream joint‑venture gasoline models down 40%, and luxury brands slipping 33%.

items.title: 貝森特盛讚美中磋商「非常成功」 雙方將建立AI通報機制
items.title_en: Biden Praises US-China Talks as "Extremely Successful," Both Sides to Set Up AI Notification Mechanism
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特表示，在美中兩國元首本週舉行峰會前夕，他與中國中方官員就人工智慧、貿易與投資等議題展開的談話「非常成功」。
貝森特在紐約與中國國務院副總理何立峰等官員進行數小時會談後向記者表示，雙方同意建立AI對話機制，並就共同目標與威脅交換意見。雙方計畫再次會晤，中國國際貿易談判代表李成鋼表示，工作小組周一將繼續磋商。
貝森特說：「美方提議在兩國之間建立通報機制，我們希望對共同目標與共同威脅形成一致看法。」他並指出，這項機制將命名為「美中AI對話」。
美國貿易代表葛里爾（Jamieson Greer）表示，雙方正在為川普總統與習近平主席週四的成功會晤「奠定基礎」。李成鋼先前則表示，此次磋商氣氛良好。
貝森特與何立峰上一次面對面會談，是約4個月前在首爾附近舉行，當時距離川普5月訪問北京僅數日。川普本周四，將在白宮接待習近平，這也是這位中國領導人十多年來首度對華府進行國是訪問。
此次會談的首要議題之一，是延長美中貿易休戰協議。雙方先前均調降關稅並放寬出口限制，但相關協議將於11月到期。
消息人士透露，針對貿易夥伴產能過剩指控而研擬的新一輪美國關稅公告，已決定延至此次會後再行公布。
《彭博》先前報導，美中雙方正積極尋求降低美國能源與農產品的關稅；這是今年稍早啟動的「貿易委員會」機制之一環，旨在藉由更廣泛的倡議，消弭雙方各值300億美元商品的貿易壁壘。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said that the discussions she held with Chinese officials on artificial intelligence, trade and investment were "extremely successful" on the eve of the summit between the two heads of state this week.

After several hours of talks in New York with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and other officials, Yellen told reporters that the parties agreed to establish an AI dialogue mechanism and to exchange views on shared goals and threats. The two sides plan to meet again, and China’s international trade negotiation representative Li Chenggang said the working group will continue its talks on Monday.

Yellen said: "The U.S. proposes to set up a notification mechanism between the two countries, and we hope to reach a common view on shared objectives and threats." She added that the mechanism will be called the "U.S.-China AI Dialogue."

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the two sides are laying the groundwork for a successful meeting on Thursday between President Trump and President Xi Jinping. Li Chenggang previously noted that the atmosphere of the talks was positive.

The last face‑to‑face meeting between Yellen and He Lifeng was about four months ago near Seoul, just days before Trump’s May visit to Beijing. This Thursday, Trump will host Xi at the White House, marking the Chinese leader’s first state visit to Washington in more than a decade.

One of the primary topics of the meeting was extending the U.S.-China trade cease‑fire agreement. Both sides have previously lowered tariffs and eased export restrictions, but the agreement is set to expire in November.
Sources said that a new round of U.S. tariff announcements being drafted in response to accusations of overcapacity by trade partners has been postponed until after this meeting.

Bloomberg previously reported that the U.S. and China are actively seeking to reduce tariffs on U.S. energy and agricultural products; this is part of the "Trade Committee" mechanism launched earlier this year, aimed at removing trade barriers on roughly $30 billion worth of goods on each side.

items.title: 卡達：美國希望與伊朗達成協議
items.title_en: Qatar: United States Hopes to Reach an Agreement with Iran
paras: 卡達外交部發言人馬吉德·安薩里20日（周日）表示，卡達正與美國和伊朗保持溝通，推動美伊恢復談判。他說，多名美國政府官員表示，美方希望達成協議，結束衝突。
安薩里在美國紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇期間表示，過去幾周卡達一直與美國和伊朗交換意見，努力彌合分歧，但他沒有給出談判恢復的時間表。
他說：「我們聽到多名美國政府官員表態，確認美國希望達成協議，希望找到結束這場戰爭的解決方案。」
安薩里表示，任何解決方案都應確保中東穩定，同時推動國際社會就保護包括荷姆茲海峽在內的戰略水道達成共識。他指出，曼德海峽目前也受到中東衝突影響。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部稱，情報顯示，美國為了掩蓋失敗，並試圖從這場戰爭中攫取利益，其在某歐洲國家舉行聯合會議後，已在某些中東地區國家默許下，決定再次對伊朗採取敵對行動。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部警告，一旦美國針對伊朗犯下任何錯誤，其在中東的所有基地及利益目標，都將毫無保留遭受持續、有效且慘痛的打擊。
伊朗哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部告誡各地區國家，若繼續對伊朗奉行「兩面派政策」，並與敵人合作，將被視為共犯，屆時將無法再指望伊朗武裝力量保持克制或容忍。
paras_en: Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesperson Majid Al-Ansari said on Sunday the 20th that Qatar is maintaining communications with the United States and Iran to push for a resumption of US‑Iran talks. He noted that several U.S. government officials have indicated that Washington wants to strike a deal and end the conflict.

During the Qatar Economic Forum in New York, Al‑Ansari said that over the past few weeks Qatar has been exchanging views with the United States and Iran, working to bridge differences, but he did not provide a timetable for the renewal of negotiations.
He said, “We have heard multiple U.S. officials state that the United States wants to reach an agreement and find a solution to end this war.”

Al‑Ansari added that any solution must ensure stability in the Middle East while also pushing the international community toward consensus on protecting strategic waterways, including the Hormuz Strait. He noted that the Strait of Mand also currently feels the impact of the Middle‑East conflict.

Iran’s Hatam Amria Central Command claimed that intelligence shows the United States, in order to cover up failures and try to profit from the war, after holding a joint meeting in a certain European country, has decided— with tacit approval from some Middle‑East states— to take hostile action against Iran again.

The Hatam Amria Central Command warned that if the United States makes any mistake against Iran, all of its bases and interest targets in the Middle East will face relentless, effective and painful strikes without restraint.

The Hatam Amria Central Command cautioned regional countries that if they continue to pursue a “double‑deal” policy toward Iran and cooperate with its enemies, they will be treated as accomplices and can no longer expect Iranian armed forces to exercise restraint or tolerance.

items.title: IBS最新預測：Token日耗數千兆、DRAM衝破上兆美元 半導體陷製程「先進缺、成熟剩」的超級短缺
items.title_en: IBS Latest Forecast: AI Tokens Consuming Trillions Daily, DRAM Surpassing a Trillion Dollars, Semiconductor Industry Faces a Super Shortage of ‘Advanced Process Deficit, Mature Process Surplus’
paras: 國際商業戰略公司(IBS)最新預測，全球半導體市場規模將由2020年4467億美元，升至2026年約1.586兆美元、2030年2.585兆美元、2035年4.678兆美元。IBS指出，原估2030年才達1兆美元的目標被AI提前約四年實現。
研調機構顧能(Gartner)亦給出相近總量，預估今年全球半導體收入1.6兆美元，較去年8090億美元增92%，其中記憶體收入約8370億美元、佔比升至54%，2027年記憶體有望破1兆美元。
需求端核心變量是推理token。根據IBS估算，中美每日AI token消耗將由去年Q1中國34兆、美國3兆，升至2030年Q1中國3500兆、美國2250兆。根據OpenRouter統計，今年8月初中國大模型週調用量約34.25兆，連續多週領先美國。
IBS創辦人Handel Jones指出，輝達自Hopper、Blackwell到Rubin，每百萬token計算成本由4.20美元降至0.12-0.01美元區間，但產業仍要把Token成本再降兩到三個數量級，才能支撐Agentic AI與超大規模推理。token暴增直接轉化為GPU、HBM、高速網路、先進封裝與電力基礎設施的同步擴產。
記憶體是本輪最緊環節。IBS預估，DRAM市場由2020年703億美元、2025年1425億美元，升至2026年6055億美元、2030年1.075兆美元、2035年1.844兆美元；顧能則預估2026年DRAM收入年增246.6%、NAND收入年增371.9%。
記憶體漲價主因在產能重配：三星、SK海力士、美光把成熟製程與部分DDR產能轉向HBM及企業級3D NAND，雲端廠商長單協議(LTA)鎖貨後，消費級SSD、行動與PC記憶體被迫承受剩餘產能溢價。
SK集團會長崔泰源稱客戶需求接近翻倍，2027年恐現史上最嚴重存儲短缺。根據IBS供需比數據，HBM約58%、DRAM離散產品約60%，NAND約74%—85%，均低於100%的供需平衡線。三星、SK海力士、美光已就2027年DRAM與HBM產能分配洽談，市場傳多數客戶最終配額僅為初始申請量60%—70%，但此類配貨比例應視為談判與渠道抽樣，不宜當作全行業確定值。
晶圓代工與先進封裝同步告急。IBS預估代工市場2025年1656億美元、2030年4711億美元、2035年破1兆；其中≤2奈米製程2030年約1774億美元。台積電2奈米進入量產、排期至2028年，3奈米與CoWoS持續滿載，今年資本支出上調至600—640億美元，約七至八成用於先進製程，其餘用於特殊製程、先進封裝與光罩。
IBS指出，≤2奈米加速器供需比由今年第一季89%降至2028年第一季73%，5/4/3奈米加速器同期由約74%—73%徘徊，智慧手機與CPU先進節點亦低於100%。相對地，28/22奈米 MCU、16/14/12奈米雜項及多數＞28奈米模擬、電源管理、影像感測均高於100%，成熟製程呈過剩。這種「先進製程缺、成熟製程鬆」的分化，使AI晶片擴量受制於前段製程、後段CoWoS與HBM三者同時補產。
資本開支正以軍備競賽速度放大。IBS指出，全球主要半導體企業資本支出由去年約1633億美元升至今年2584億美元、年增58.3%，其中台積電與三星各約620億美元，美光逾250億美元、SK海力士約310億美元，英特爾則趨穩於150-160億美元。
需求方面，IBS估算主要資料中心資本支出由去年5724億美元增至2026年1.1兆美元，亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟、Meta四家合計近7500億美元；TrendForce統計更納入甲骨文、字節跳動、騰訊、阿里、百度等九家雲端廠商，今年合計超8867億美元，並據此上修AI伺服器出貨增速至近31%。
但高支出反噬現金流：亞馬遜、谷歌、Meta近期自由現金流轉弱或部分轉負，穆迪示警六大科技巨頭AI投資推高資產負債表風險；IBS同時把「足夠半導體與電力」列為資料中心資本支出達標的主要挑戰。
總體來看，若IBS與顧能預測準確，半導體將由週期型產業轉為AI基礎設施型產業：記憶體從配角變戰略資源，先進製程與封裝決定GPU供給，電力與HBM配貨決定雲廠擴產上限。短期風險在價格跑在產能前——記憶體合約價、VLCC式運力與設備交期已反映短缺；中長期風險在2028年前後若資料中心資本支出走緩、DRAM新產能釋出，恐出現局部修正。
對供應鏈而言，HBM、2奈米製程、CoWoS、先進材料與設備是確定性最高的擴產方向；對下游消費電子與汽車晶片而言，則要防先進產能擠佔與成熟製程價格波動的雙向擠壓。
paras_en: IBS (International Business Strategies) now forecasts that the global semiconductor market will grow from $446.7 billion in 2020 to about $1.586 trillion in 2026, $2.585 trillion in 2030 and $4.678 trillion in 2035. IBS notes that the $1 trillion target originally expected for 2030 is being reached about four years early thanks to AI.

Research firm Gartner gives a similar total, estimating global semiconductor revenue this year at $1.6 trillion, up 92% from last year’s $809 billion. Memory revenue is about $837 billion, accounting for 54% of the total, and memory sales could break $1 trillion by 2027.

The key demand driver is inference tokens. IBS estimates that daily AI token consumption in China and the United States will rise from 34 trillion in China and 3 trillion in the U.S. in Q1 of last year to 3,500 trillion in China and 2,250 trillion in the U.S. by Q1 2030. OpenRouter data shows that in early August this year China’s large‑model weekly calls were about 34.25 trillion, staying ahead of the U.S. for several weeks.

IBS founder Handel Jones points out that Nvidia’s cost per million tokens has dropped from $4.20 to a range of $0.12‑$0.01 from the Hopper to Blackwell to Rubin architectures, but the industry still needs to cut token costs another two to three orders of magnitude to support agentic AI and massive‑scale inference. The token surge directly translates into synchronized expansion of GPUs, HBM, high‑speed networking, advanced packaging and power infrastructure.

Memory is the tightest link in this cycle. IBS projects the DRAM market to grow from $70.3 billion in 2020 and $142.5 billion in 2025 to $605.5 billion in 2026, $1.075 trillion in 2030 and $1.844 trillion in 2035; Gartner forecasts a 246.6% annual growth for DRAM and 371.9% for NAND in 2026.

Memory price increases are mainly due to capacity reallocation: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are shifting mature‑process and some DDR capacity to HBM and enterprise‑grade 3D NAND. After cloud providers lock in long‑term agreements (LTA), consumer SSD, mobile and PC memory are forced to bear the premium on the remaining capacity.

SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won says customer demand is nearly doubling and a historic storage shortage could hit in 2027. IBS supply‑demand ratios show HBM at about 58%, discrete‑product DRAM around 60%, NAND at 74‑85%—all below the 100% balance line. Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are already negotiating DRAM and HBM capacity allocations for 2027; the market hears that most customers will ultimately receive only 60‑70% of their initial requests, but such allocation ratios reflect negotiations and channel sampling rather than firm industry‑wide values.

Foundry and advanced‑packaging capacity are both tightening. IBS estimates the foundry market at $165.6 billion in 2025, $471.1 billion in 2030 and over $1 trillion in 2035, with sub‑2 nm processes accounting for about $177.4 billion in 2030. TSMC’s 2‑nm production is slated for volume ramp‑up by 2028, while 3‑nm and CoWoS remain fully booked. This year’s capex is raised to $60‑$64 billion, roughly 70‑80% of which is earmarked for advanced nodes, the rest for specialty processes, advanced packaging and photomasks.

IBS notes that the supply‑demand ratio for ≤2‑nm accelerators falls from 89% in Q1 2023 to 73% in Q1 2028, while 5/4/3‑nm accelerators hover around 73‑74% in the same period. Advanced‑node smartphones and CPUs are also below 100%. Conversely, 28/22‑nm MCUs, 16/14/12‑nm miscellaneous parts and most >28‑nm analog, power‑management and image‑sensor components are above 100%, indicating excess capacity in mature processes. This “advanced‑process shortage, mature‑process slack” split means AI chip scaling is constrained by front‑end nodes, back‑end CoWoS and HBM capacity simultaneously.

Capital spending is accelerating like an arms race. IBS says global semiconductor‑major capex rose from about $163.3 billion last year to $258.4 billion this year, a 58.3% year‑over‑year increase. TSMC and Samsung each plan roughly $62 billion, Micron over $25 billion, SK Hynix about $31 billion, and Intel steadies around $15‑$16 billion.

On the demand side, IBS estimates data‑center capex will climb from $572.4 billion last year to $1.1 trillion in 2026, with Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta together accounting for nearly $750 billion. TrendForce’s tally, which adds Oracle, ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba and Baidu, puts nine cloud players at over $886.7 billion this year and lifts the AI‑server shipment growth forecast to close to 31%.

However, high spending is hurting cash flow: Amazon, Google and Meta have recently seen weakening or even negative free cash flow, and Moody’s warns that AI investments by the six big tech firms are raising balance‑sheet risk. IBS also lists “sufficient semiconductors and power” as a primary challenge for meeting data‑center capex targets.

Overall, if IBS and Gartner’s forecasts hold, the semiconductor sector will shift from a cyclical industry to an AI‑infrastructure industry: memory moves from a supporting role to a strategic resource, advanced processes and packaging dictate GPU supply, and power and HBM allocations set the ceiling for cloud‑provider expansion. Short‑term risk lies in prices running ahead of capacity—memory contract prices, VLCC‑style freight capacity and equipment lead times already reflect shortages; medium‑ to long‑term risk emerges around 2028 if data‑center capex slows and new DRAM capacity comes online, potentially prompting a localized correction.

For the supply chain, HBM, 2‑nm processes, CoWoS, advanced materials and equipment are the most certain expansion avenues; downstream consumer electronics and automotive chips must guard against a two‑way squeeze from advanced‑node capacity crowding and mature‑process price volatility.

items.title: 印度「SEMICON India 2026」峰會揭幕，官方宣布半導體2.0計畫擴大投資至104億美元
items.title_en: India "SEMICON India 2026" Summit Opens, Government Announces Semiconductor 2.0 Plan Expands Investment to $10.4 Billion
paras: 2026年09月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 印度半導體產業布局正從晶圓廠建設向設備、材料、先進封裝及研發等環節擴大。印度政府推進Semicon 2.0，目前相關生態系已取得約1兆印度盧比投資承諾，預計未來2至3年陸續落地，並有望創造接近10萬個新增就業機會。
Semicon 2.0聚焦半導體設計、設備與材料、晶圓廠、先進封裝、研發及人才培育六大領域。相較第一階段著重建立產業基礎，新一階段更強調上下游供應鏈完整度，並吸引國際設備、材料及技術業者進入印度。
其中，塔塔電子Tata Electronics近期合作布局最為密集。公司與荷蘭半導體業者Nexperia簽署MOU，合作涵蓋半導體晶圓製造、組裝與測試、技術合作及創新，並同步向材料、先進封裝及供應鏈在地化延伸。
材料方面，Tata Electronics與富士軟片Fujifilm合作，推動印度關鍵半導體材料在地化；另與JSR簽署MOU，由JSR為Tata Electronics位於古吉拉特邦Dholera的晶圓廠供應光阻及先進化學品。隨著晶圓廠建設推進，印度正同步建立製程所需的材料供應能力。
先進封裝也是Tata Electronics擴張重點。公司與BESI Singapore簽署MOU，合作建立印度先進半導體封裝能力；另與印度Semiconductor Laboratory(SCL)合作，範圍涵蓋半導體設計服務、製程技術、供應鏈在地化及人才培育。
為加快晶圓廠周邊供應商進駐，Tata Electronics並與Ascendas First Space合作，規劃在Dholera開發363英畝供應商園區，建立晶圓廠供應鏈聚落。公司也與Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya合作，結合L&T EduTech及Jacobs Solutions，培育半導體廠務工程與基礎設施系統所需人才。
印度本土業者也加快封裝與測試布局。Kaynes Semicon與OptoML India簽署MOU，將共同開發先進半導體封裝及System-on-Module解決方案；Kaynes Semicon另與GridCrest Technologies及Sensesemi合作，探索半導體封裝、組裝及測試商機。

其他廠商方面，Suchi Semicon與eInfochips已交換首批商用元件；HORIBA成立HORIBA KOACH Experience Centre；Sensesemi Technologies與GridCrest Technologies則簽署MOU，合作開發智慧電表解決方案。印度半導體業者CDIL也宣布進入商業生產，並與日本Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Company合作開發封裝。
國際半導體設備商也開始深化印度布局。據Dow Jones Newswires報導，應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)計畫未來10年持續投資印度。半導體產品事業群總裁Prabu Raja表示，相關投資將協助公司深化當地研發，並培育未來半導體人才。
人才方面，India Semiconductor Mission與英特爾Intel(INTC-US)印度推出半導體入門課程，Intel India另與New Age Makers' Institute of Technology(NAMTECH)簽署MOU，合作培育AI與半導體人才。印度政府則設定未來5年培訓10萬名技術人員的目標，並將與包括台灣工研院(ITRI)在內的國際機構合作建立培訓能力。
此外，印度政府計畫將半導體設計新創扶植目標擴大至200家。第一階段獲支持的105家半導體新創中，已有20家取得創投資金；目前約400所大學及研究機構參與半導體晶片設計教育，後續課程將進一步從晶片設計延伸至系統設計。

paras_en: September 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – India’s semiconductor industry is expanding its focus from fab construction to equipment, materials, advanced packaging and R&D. The government’s Semicon 2.0 initiative has already secured roughly 1 trillion Indian rupees in investment commitments, which are expected to materialise over the next two to three years and could create close to 100,000 new jobs.

Semicon 2.0 targets six pillars: semiconductor design, equipment and materials, fabs, advanced packaging, R&D and talent development. Unlike the first phase, which centred on building a basic industry foundation, the new phase emphasises a complete upstream‑downstream supply chain and aims to attract international equipment, material and technology firms to India.

Tata Electronics is the most active partner in recent collaborations. The company signed an MOU with Dutch semiconductor firm Nexperia covering wafer manufacturing, assembly and testing, technology cooperation and innovation, while also extending into materials, advanced packaging and localising the supply chain.

On the materials side, Tata Electronics teamed up with Fujifilm to localise critical semiconductor materials in India; it also signed an MOU with JSR, which will supply photoresist and advanced chemicals to Tata’s fab in Dholera, Gujarat. As fab construction progresses, India is simultaneously building the material supply capacity needed for the processes.

Advanced packaging is another key expansion area for Tata Electronics. The firm signed an MOU with BESI Singapore to develop advanced semiconductor packaging capability in India, and partnered with the Indian Semiconductor Laboratory (SCL) on semiconductor design services, process technology, supply‑chain localisation and talent development.

To accelerate the entry of fab‑adjacent suppliers, Tata Electronics is working with Ascendas First Space to develop a 363‑acre supplier park in Dholera, creating a fab‑centric supply‑chain ecosystem. It also collaborates with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya, L&T EduTech and Jacobs Solutions to train talent for semiconductor plant engineering and infrastructure systems.

Domestic players are also speeding up packaging and testing efforts. Kaynes Semicon and OptoML India signed an MOU to co‑develop advanced semiconductor packaging and System‑on‑Module solutions; Kaynes Semicon further partnered with GridCrest Technologies and Sensesemi to explore packaging, assembly and testing opportunities.

Other companies highlighted include Suchi Semicon, which has exchanged its first batch of commercial components with eInfochips; HORIBA, which opened the HORIBA KOACH Experience Centre; and Sensesemi Technologies, which signed an MOU with GridCrest Technologies to develop smart‑meter solutions. Indian semiconductor firm CDIL announced it is moving into commercial production and is working with Japan’s Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Company on packaging development.

International semiconductor equipment makers are deepening their India footprint. Dow Jones Newswires reported that Applied Materials (AMAT-US) plans to continue investing in India over the next ten years. Prabu Raja, president of the semiconductor products division, said the investments will help deepen local R&D and cultivate future semiconductor talent.

On the talent front, the India Semiconductor Mission and Intel (INTC-US) launched an introductory semiconductor course in India, while Intel India signed an MOU with New Age Makers' Institute of Technology (NAMTECH) to train AI and semiconductor talent. The Indian government has set a target to train 100,000 technical personnel over the next five years and will work with international bodies, including Taiwan’s ITRI, to build training capacity.

The government also plans to expand its support for semiconductor design startups to 200 companies. Of the 105 startups backed in the first phase, 20 have already secured venture funding; roughly 400 universities and research institutes are involved in semiconductor chip‑design education, and curricula will later extend from chip design to system design.

items.title: 中國DRAM追趕腳步加快長鑫科技G5平台量產、單片晶圓Die數增逾50%
items.title_en: China DRAM Accelerates Catch‑up as CXMT’s G5 Platform Enters Mass Production, Wafer Die Count Up Over 50%
paras: 2026年09月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國DRAM大廠長鑫科技CXMT(688825-CN)宣布，第5代DRAM技術平台G5正式量產，以8Gb晶片計算，單片晶圓Die數較第4代平台增加至少50%，並同步推出兩款24Gb LPDDR5X產品，擴大高階行動記憶體布局。
CXMT表示，G5平台採用四重曝光技術，將記憶體陣列主動區半間距縮小至11.95奈米，透過製程微縮提高記憶體密度與單片晶圓產出，並改善能源效率及成本控制。
此次推出的兩款LPDDR5X產品，單顆晶片容量均達24Gb，較上一代同類產品提高50%，分別採用496 Ball及245 Ball封裝規格，鎖定中高階智慧手機及可攜式消費電子，目前均已進入大規模量產。
下一代產品方面，CXMT自行開發的LPDDR6也已量產商用，並搭載小米Xiaomi 18 Fold摺疊旗艦手機，容量16GB、最高傳輸速度12,800Mbps。公司預期，LPDDR6未來應用將延伸至電腦、智慧汽車、邊緣伺服器、智慧穿戴裝置及機器人。
供應鏈方面，CXMT也開始跨出中國品牌客戶，進入國際PC廠供應體系。據Nikkei Asia報導，惠普HP(HPQ-US)、華碩(2357-TW)及宏碁(2353-TW)已在部分筆電小量採用CXMT DRAM，多家主要PC品牌約於今年年中完成產品認證，目前導入數量及機種仍有限，相關筆電主要在美國以外市場銷售。
全球記憶體供應吃緊，也為CXMT拓展PC客戶帶來機會。部分PC業者取得更多CPU供應後，正尋求更多相容記憶體來源。不過，CXMT目前仍將相當部分產能優先供應華為等中國客戶，國際PC品牌現階段仍以小量導入為主。
CXMT在中國市場已供應騰訊Tencent(0700-HK)、阿里雲及字節跳動ByteDance等科技業者。在DRAM供應緊張下，CXMT產品價格並未明顯低於三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)等主要供應商，部分客戶也無法取得本季以後的供貨承諾，顯示DRAM產能仍供不應求。
產能方面，CXMT正擴建上海生產基地，目標將當地產能提高至合肥總部的2至3倍，並規劃高頻寬記憶體(HBM)產能。隨著G5、LPDDR5X及LPDDR6量產，加上切入國際PC供應鏈及擴充HBM產能，CXMT產品布局正從傳統DRAM延伸至高階行動裝置、PC及AI記憶體市場。

paras_en: On September 21, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China’s major DRAM maker ChangXin Technology CXMT (688825-CN) announced that its 5th‑generation DRAM technology platform G5 is now in full‑scale production. Based on an 8‑Gb chip calculation, the number of dies per wafer on a single wafer has increased by at least 50% compared with the 4th‑generation platform, and the company simultaneously launched two 24‑Gb LPDDR5X products to expand its high‑end mobile memory portfolio.

CXMT said the G5 platform uses quadruple‑patterning technology, shrinking the active half‑pitch of the memory array to 11.95 nm. This process shrink boosts memory density and wafer output per die, while also improving energy efficiency and cost control.

The two newly launched LPDDR5X products each have a 24‑Gb chip capacity, a 50% increase over the previous generation’s comparable offerings. They employ 496‑ball and 245‑ball package specifications respectively, targeting mid‑to‑high‑end smartphones and portable consumer electronics, and are already in large‑scale mass production.

Regarding next‑generation products, CXMT’s in‑house developed LPDDR6 is already in commercial mass production and is featured in Xiaomi’s 18 Fold flagship folding phone with a 16‑GB capacity and a peak transfer speed of 12,800 Mbps. The company expects LPDDR6 applications to later extend to computers, smart cars, edge servers, wearables and robotics.

On the supply‑chain side, CXMT is also beginning to reach beyond Chinese‑brand customers into the international PC supplier ecosystem. According to Nikkei Asia, HP (HPQ‑US), ASUS (2357‑TW) and Acer (2353‑TW) have already adopted CXMT DRAM in small volumes for some laptop models, with major PC brands expected to complete product qualification around mid‑year. Current adoption volumes and model counts remain limited, and the laptops are primarily sold outside the United States.

Tight global memory supply also creates opportunities for CXMT to expand its PC customer base. Some PC makers, after securing more CPU supply, are looking for additional compatible memory sources. However, CXMT still prioritises a substantial portion of capacity for Chinese customers such as Huawei, and international PC brands are currently only introducing CXMT memory in small quantities.

CXMT already supplies major Chinese tech firms including Tencent (0700‑HK), Alibaba Cloud and ByteDance. Despite the DRAM shortage, CXMT’s product prices are not markedly lower than those of leading suppliers like Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR), and some customers cannot obtain supply commitments beyond the current quarter, indicating that DRAM capacity remains insufficient to meet demand.

In terms of capacity, CXMT is expanding its Shanghai manufacturing base, aiming to raise local output to two‑ to three‑times that of its Hefei headquarters, and is also planning high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) production. With G5, LPDDR5X and LPDDR6 now in mass production, entry into the international PC supply chain and HBM capacity expansion, CXMT’s product portfolio is extending from traditional DRAM to high‑end mobile devices, PCs and AI memory markets.

items.title: 沙國首都敏感目標遭襲 胡塞同意不與美國交戰
items.title_en: Saudi Capital Sensitive Target Attacked, Houthis Agree Not to Fight the United States
paras: 葉門叛軍胡塞19日（周六）晚宣布，發動兩次軍事行動，分別襲擊了沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的「敏感目標」以及Saudi Aramco公司位於延布的設施。
胡塞發言人葉海亞·薩雷亞當日在馬西拉電視台上表示，武裝部隊在上述軍事行動中使用「大量彈道飛彈、有翼飛彈和無人機」。
薩雷亞稱，這兩次行動是對沙國空襲的回應，均取得成功。本輪衝突以來，沙國已對葉門發動732次空襲。胡塞將繼續執行「以封鎖對封鎖，以升級對升級」的方針。
土耳其外長費丹19日表示，針對沙國近期遭受攻擊，土耳其將信守《麥加共同防務協議》承諾，並可能給予沙國軍事技術方面的援助。
費丹在參加土耳其NTV電視台節目時表示，協議簽署國正在密切關注胡塞對沙國的襲擊。他說：「我們在這個問題上團結一致，協議包含相關條款，我們將信守承諾。」他特別譴責針對石油基礎設施的攻擊。
美國總統川普20日對《Fox News》說，美國同胡塞保持溝通，胡塞同意不與美國交戰。
匿名美國官員披露，迄今為止，美國軍方提供的支援僅限於為沙國針對胡塞的打擊行動提供情報和目標數據，近期就此加大與沙國的共享力道，美方認為已向沙國提供其對抗胡塞「所需一切支援」。
沙國王儲兼首相穆罕默德本月早些時候曾要求美方打擊胡塞，但遭川普拒絕。
分析人士認為，胡塞近期攻勢可能會「開闢新戰線」，延長美伊衝突，提高美國使用外交和軍事手段結束美伊衝突的難度。
paras_en: On Saturday night, Yemen’s Houthi rebels announced that they carried out two military operations, striking a “sensitive target” in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, and a facility of Saudi Aramco in Yanbu.
Houthi spokesperson Yehia Saleh told Masirah TV that the armed forces used “large numbers of ballistic missiles, winged missiles and drones” in the operations.

Saleh said the two attacks were a response to Saudi airstrikes and were successful. Since the latest round of fighting began, Saudi Arabia has launched 732 airstrikes against Yemen. The Houthis will continue to follow a policy of “block for block, escalation for escalation.”

Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu said on the 19th that, in light of the recent attacks on Saudi Arabia, Turkey will honor its commitments under the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement and may provide Saudi Arabia with military‑technical assistance.

Speaking on a program on Turkey’s NTV channel, Çavuşoğlu said the signatory states are closely monitoring the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. “We are united on this issue; the agreement contains relevant clauses and we will keep our promise,” he said, specifically condemning attacks on oil infrastructure.
U.S. President Donald Trump told Fox News on the 20th that the United States remains in communication with the Houthis and that the Houthis have agreed not to fight the United States.

An anonymous U.S. official disclosed that, to date, U.S. military support has been limited to providing intelligence and targeting data for Saudi operations against the Houthis, but that the United States has recently increased the level of sharing with Saudi Arabia, saying it has provided “all the support needed” for Saudi efforts against the Houthis.
Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman had earlier this month asked the United States to strike the Houthis, a request that President Trump rejected.

Analysts believe the Houthis’ recent offensives could open a new front, prolong the U.S.–Iran conflict and make it harder for the United States to use diplomatic and military means to end the U.S.–Iran confrontation.

items.title: 股債等多類資產年底或「同步」上漲？高盛：市場升息預期過度悲觀
paras: 高盛策略師認為，市場目前對全球主要央行升息路徑的定價過於悲觀，若通膨壓力隨油價回落而緩解，年底前可能出現股債等多類資產「同步」上漲的交易機會。
高盛研究部高級顧問Dominic Wilson與全球風險主管Josh Schiffrin於近日參加高盛Podcast節目時表示，市場目前預期本輪升息次數約達4次，但實際升息幅度可能僅有2次。
兩人均認為，油價走勢將是決定最終升息路徑的關鍵因素。若能源價格明顯回落，通膨預期可能降溫，進而為債券、股票等多類資產帶來同步走強的條件。
在能源價格大幅反彈、通膨預期升溫的背景下，市場對聯準會（Fed）未來升息幅度的預期持續升高。
Schiffrin表示，油價飆升是今年市場最大的意外之一，除了推升通膨預期，也讓市場對貨幣政策的定價更加激進。
他指出，市場已大幅反映一個完整的緊縮週期，預期升息約4次，但他認為最終升息次數不會達到這個水準；若必須提出具體預測，他傾向於2次。
Wilson也認同這項看法，並表示其基準情境是「10月再升息1次，之後長期暫停」。
Wilson指出，目前市場對聯準會、歐洲央行、日本及加拿大央行的升息幅度，均反映接近4次的預期，但實際升息力度可能低於市場預期。
他認為，若要在升息2次與6次之間做出判斷，升息2次的機率明顯較高。

長天期債券殖利率處高檔　油價回落成反轉關鍵

近期市場持續擔憂財政赤字、通膨黏著性及資本需求競爭等問題，但Schiffrin認為，債券市場已消化大量利空，投資吸引力正在提高。
他指出，10年期美國公債殖利率已升至5%以上，30年期實質殖利率也超過3%，這類票息與實質殖利率水準已是相當長時間未見的高點。
不過，Schiffrin表示，債券市場若要出現反轉，仍需要催化因素，而最可能的觸發點就是油價下跌。
Wilson則從結構面分析實質利率走高的原因。他表示，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動企業融資需求增加，加上政府財政赤字擴大，推升資本競爭壓力；另一方面，經濟成長仍具韌性，也使通膨降溫速度低於預期，進一步支撐較高的政策利率。
他認為，在企業融資需求與經濟成長前景出現實質變化前，長天期公債殖利率大幅下滑的空間有限。
不過，Wilson指出，若AI資本支出週期出現轉折，或經濟遭遇超出預期的下行衝擊，長天期殖利率仍可能明顯回落，但這兩種情境目前都不是高盛的基準預測。

美股展現韌性　年底「全資產上漲」仍待油價配合

Schiffrin表示，美股近期面對油價上漲、殖利率大幅走高及AI監管不確定性等多重壓力，表現卻明顯優於預期。
他認為，這表示市場具有相當韌性，部分反映當前大規模資本支出週期，以及實體經濟仍然強勁。
Wilson則指出，市場目前已反映相當程度的悲觀預期，包括升息4次、實質殖利率上升，以及油價突破每桶100美元等因素。因此，市場未來若出現緩解訊號，反而更容易出現價格修正。
他形容，當前是近期多頭投資者相對清晰的布局窗口，雖然條件不如7月底，但市場氛圍有相似之處。
針對年底前的交易方向，Schiffrin提出3項觀察：

美元可能受到聯準會相對鷹派立場及美國經濟領先優勢支撐而走強。
若美國期中選舉後油價下跌，市場可能出現「全資產上漲」行情，但前提是油價回落。
從中長期來看，超長天期公債目前偏高的實質殖利率仍具配置價值。


Wilson則表示，考慮到市場目前的升息定價，以及通膨可能透過多種途徑降溫，他對年底前利率定價出現修正的信心日益增加，並傾向透過低成本選擇權策略參與潛在行情。

items.title: 風向要變了？對沖基金近一年多來首次看漲日元
items.title_en: Is the Wind Changing? Hedge Funds Turn Bullish on the Yen for the First Time in Over a Year
paras: 日本央行升息之際，對沖基金對日元的立場出現重大轉向，自2025年7月以來首次轉為淨多頭，顯示在美日兩國當局入市干預後，外匯市場情緒已明顯改變。
不過，日本央行最新政策訊號不如部分投資人預期鷹派，使剛轉向看漲日元的交易商立即面臨壓力。
根據美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）上周五(18日)公布的數據，截至9月15日當周，槓桿交易商已全數回補先前建立的日元空頭部位，並開始轉向做多日元。
彭博彙整數據顯示，相關基金目前持有約2,510億日元（約16億美元）的日元多頭部位。這是自2025年7月以來，對沖基金首度對日元持淨看漲立場，反映投機資金對日元後市的看法出現明顯逆轉。
這波倉位調整發生在美日當局入市干預數周後。根據彭博先前報導，美國財政部長貝森特曾表示，美方參與日元干預屬於「象徵性」行動，並表態支持美國出口競爭力。官方行動及政策訊號，成為市場重新評估日元走勢的重要因素。
日銀訊號不夠鷹派
對沖基金完成多空立場轉換的時機相當微妙。聯準會與日本央行本周相繼調高利率，但日本央行對未來政策的表態，未能滿足部分市場參與者對持續升息的預期，導致日元在升息後反而走弱，也讓剛建立多頭部位的交易商陷入被動。
日元周五盤中一度下跌1.3%，隨後跌幅收窄，紐約尾盤報約156.80日元兌1美元。根據《日經新聞》報導，日本央行已向市場參與者詢問匯率水準。此類「匯率詢價」通常被市場視為官方可能出手干預的前兆，消息傳出後，日元跌勢隨即有所緩和。
美元多頭同步降溫
與此同時，包括資產管理機構及非商業交易商在內的投機性交易人，截至9月15日已將美元淨多頭部位降至3月以來最低水準，顯示市場先前不僅提高對日元的看漲押注，也同步降低對美元的多頭布局。
然而，美元本周隨後強勢反彈，單周漲幅創下近三個月最大，使先前減持美元的交易商同樣承受壓力。日元多頭增加、美元多頭降溫，與本周實際匯率走勢形成落差，凸顯央行政策訊號仍主導短線外匯市場。
CFTC持倉數據提供市場觀察外匯交易情緒的重要窗口，反映對沖基金與資產管理機構透過衍生性金融商品建立的整體部位方向。
目前全球外匯市場日均成交規模達9.5兆美元，日元能否延續看漲氣氛，仍取決於日本央行後續升息訊號及官方是否進一步干預匯市。
paras_en: As the Bank of Japan raises rates, hedge funds have made a major shift in their yen stance, moving to a net long position for the first time since July 2025, indicating that forex market sentiment has clearly changed after interventions by U.S. and Japanese authorities.
However, the latest policy signals from the BOJ are less hawkish than some investors expected, putting immediate pressure on traders who have just turned bullish on the yen.

According to data released by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on Friday the 18th, by the week ending September 15 leveraged traders had fully covered their previously established short yen positions and begun to go long the currency.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that the relevant funds now hold about ¥251 billion (roughly $1.6 billion) of long yen positions. This is the first net‑bullish stance on the yen by hedge funds since July 2025, reflecting a clear reversal in speculative sentiment toward the currency’s outlook.

The position adjustment comes weeks after U.S. and Japanese authorities stepped into the market. Bloomberg previously reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen described the U.S. side of the yen intervention as a “symbolic” action and voiced support for U.S. export competitiveness. Official actions and policy signals have become key factors in the market’s reassessment of yen direction.
BOJ signals not hawkish enough

The timing of hedge funds’ long‑short switch is delicate. The Fed and the BOJ both raised rates this week, but the BOJ’s forward guidance failed to meet some market participants’ expectations for continued tightening, causing the yen to weaken after the rate hike and leaving newly‑long traders on the back foot.

The yen fell as much as 1.3% intraday on Friday before narrowing its loss, closing the New York session around ¥156.80 per $1. According to the Nikkei, the BOJ has queried market participants on exchange‑rate levels – a “rate inquiry” that markets usually interpret as a possible precursor to official intervention, which tempered the yen’s decline when the news broke.
Dollar bulls cool off

At the same time, speculative traders, including asset managers and non‑commercial participants, had reduced their net long dollar positions to the lowest level since March as of September 15, showing that the market not only increased its bullish bets on the yen but also scaled back its long dollar exposure.

Nevertheless, the dollar rebounded strongly later in the week, posting its biggest weekly gain in nearly three months, putting pressure on traders who had trimmed dollar exposure. The rise in yen longs and the cooling of dollar longs contrast with the week’s actual exchange‑rate moves, underscoring that central‑bank signals still dominate short‑term forex dynamics.
CFTC position data provide an important window into forex‑trading sentiment, reflecting the overall directional bias of hedge funds and asset managers through derivative instruments.

The global forex market now sees a daily turnover of about $9.5 trillion. Whether the yen can sustain its bullish momentum will still depend on the BOJ’s future rate‑hike signals and whether officials step up intervention in the currency market.

items.title: 輝達加持的AI新創Nscale申請上市！上半年營收暴增12.5倍仍虧損逾10億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Nscale Files for IPO! H1 Revenue Surges 12.5‑Fold Yet Losses Exceed $1 Billion
paras: 獲輝達(NVDA-US)投資、專注人工智慧(AI)模型基礎設施的雲端服務商Nscale，周五(18日)已向紐約證券交易所(NYSE)申請上市，股票代號為「NSCL」。
根據Nscale首次公開發行(IPO)說明書，在截至今年6月30日的六個月內期間，營收為1.406億美元，淨虧損達10.2億美元。相比之下，去年同期淨損為3.689億美元，營收僅1040萬美元，代表營收較去年同期暴增1252%。
Nscale並透露，目前為止的剩餘履約義務(RPO)達564億美元。
對手包括亞馬遜、CoreWeave
Nscale的競爭對手包括市場領先的雲端服務商亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等被稱為「新雲」(neocloud)的新一代供應商。
自2022年ChatGPT推出以來，OpenAI、Anthropic等AI實驗室對運算能力的需求似乎永無止境。因此，Anthropic與OpenAI都需要大量現金支付算力費用，兩家公司也都計劃上市。
這兩家AI實驗室都已與Nscale達成交易，由Nscale出租輝達圖形處理器(GPU)，供AI模型訓練與運行使用。
本身也是雲端服務商的微軟(MSFT-US)也已與Nscale簽約。Nscale表示，2026年上半年有一家未具名客戶貢獻超過一半營收。
尋求分散客戶、靠收購擴大AI服務
Nscale近來也試圖分散業務來源，目前已開始提供多款AI模型的推理服務。此外，7月還宣布計劃收購協助建構AI模型的新創軟體公司Anyscale。
Nscale上周宣布，曾任OpenAI、Instacart(CART-US)與Meta(META-US)高層的Fidji Simo加入董事會。其他董事會成員還包括Meta前高層Nick Clegg與桑柏格(Sheryl Sandberg)。
### 手握46.1萬顆GPU合約　但負債逾80億美元
截至8月31日，Nscale擁有2.5萬顆啟用中的GPU，若加入已啟用或已簽約的GPU，總數達46.1萬顆。公司目前擁有五座已啟用、12座已簽約的資料中心據點。
Nscale表示目前已掌握相當於10GW的運算能力，負債則超過80億美元，這個金額還沒把與AI伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)的融資計畫算進來。
Nscale總部位於倫敦，截至8月31日擁有逾1000名全職員工。該公司於2024年結束神秘模式，從加密貨幣挖礦公司Arkon Energy分拆成立，投資人包括Blue Owl、戴爾、輝達、Fidelity與Point72。
Nscale今年3月表示，在其中一輪募資中，投資人對公司的估值達146億美元。
根據Nscale向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的文件，輝達同意為Nscale在德州一項資料中心租賃協議下最高8.6億美元的義務提供擔保。

Competitors include Amazon and CoreWeave.
Nscale’s rivals comprise market‑leading cloud provider Amazon (AMZN‑US) as well as next‑generation “neocloud” suppliers such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US).

Since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have shown seemingly endless demand for compute power. Consequently, both Anthropic and OpenAI need massive cash to pay for compute and are planning IPOs themselves.
Both AI labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) to them for training and running AI models.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US), also a cloud provider, has signed a contract with Nscale. Nscale said an unnamed customer contributed more than half of its revenue in the first half of 2026.
Seeking to diversify its customer base and grow AI services through acquisitions

Nscale has recently been trying to diversify its revenue sources; it has begun offering inference services for a variety of AI models and announced in July a plan to acquire the AI‑model‑building startup Anyscale.

Last week Nscale announced that Fidji Simo, a former senior executive at OpenAI, Instacart (CART‑US) and Meta (META‑US), has joined its board. Other board members include former Meta executive Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.
### Holding contracts for 461,000 GPUs but debt exceeds $8 billion

As of August 31, Nscale operated 25,000 active GPUs; counting GPUs already activated or under contract brings the total to 461,000. The company currently runs five active data‑center sites and has contracts for twelve additional sites.
Nscale says it now controls roughly 10 GW of compute capacity, while its debt tops $8 billion, not including financing arrangements with AI‑server maker Dell (DELL‑US).

Nscale is headquartered in London and had more than 1,000 full‑time employees as of August 31. The company emerged from “stealth mode” in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency miner Arkon Energy, with investors such as Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72.
In March this year Nscale disclosed that a financing round valued the company at $14.6 billion.
SEC filings show that Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $860 million for Nscale’s Texas data‑center lease obligations.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 爆量走升收31.808元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Hot Money Returns, Stocks and Exchange Rate Rise, Volume Surges, Closing at 31.808
paras: 美國升息 1 碼，不確定因素消除，在熱錢回流下，台北股匯今 (18) 日連袂走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.5 角，終場升幅收斂，收在 31.808 元，升值 7.3 分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值爆出 39.9 億美元。

paras_en: U.S. rate hikes by one percentage point removed uncertainties, and with hot‑money inflows, Taipei’s stock and foreign‑exchange markets both rose on the 18th. The New Taiwan dollar briefly surged 0.15 NTD per USD before the gain narrowed, closing at 31.808 NTD, up 0.073 NTD, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai FX markets exploded to $3.99 billion.
